title.zh: 卷一 本紀第一 太祖一
title.raw: 卷一 本紀第一 太祖一 Volume 1 Annals 1: Taizu 1

sentences.zh: 太祖啟運立極英武睿文神德聖功至明大孝皇帝諱匡胤字元朗，姓趙氏涿郡人也。

translations.literal: Taizu, Emperor Who Initiated Fortune, Established the Pole, Martial and Sagely, Cultured and Divine in Virtue, Holy in Merit, Supremely Bright and Great in Filial Piety—his taboo name was Kuangyin, courtesy name Yuanlang, surname Zhao, a man of Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, the Emperor Who Initiated Fortune and Established the Pole, Martial and Sagely, Cultured and Divine in Virtue, Holy in Merit, Supremely Bright and Great in Filial Piety—taboo name Kuangyin, courtesy name Yuanlang, of the Zhao clan from Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 高祖朓，是為僖祖，仕唐歷永清、文安、幽都令。

translations.literal: High Ancestor Tiao is posthumously honored as Emperor Xi, and in Tang service he successively held the posts of magistrate of Yongqing, Wen'an, and Youdu.
translations.idiomatic: His High Ancestor Tiao, posthumously honored as Emperor Xi, served the Tang as magistrate of Yongqing, Wen'an, and Youdu in turn.

sentences.zh: 朓生珽，是為順祖，歷藩鎮從事，累官兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: Tiao begat Jiong, who is posthumously honored as Emperor Shun; he served as staff officer under military governors and rose to concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tiao begat Jiong, posthumously honored as Emperor Shun, who served as staff officer under military governors and rose to concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 珽生敬，是為翼祖，歷營、薊、涿三州刺史。

translations.literal: Jiong begat Jing, who is posthumously honored as Emperor Yi; he successively held the posts of prefect of Ying, Ji, and Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong begat Jing, posthumously honored as Emperor Yi, who served in turn as prefect of Ying, Ji, and Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 敬生弘殷，是為宣祖。

translations.literal: Jing begat Hongyin, who is posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jing begat Hongyin, posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 周顯德中，宣祖貴，贈敬左驍騎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the Xiande era of Zhou, when Emperor Xuan had risen in honor, Jing was posthumously enfeoffed as General-in-Chief of the Left Yaoqi Guards.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiande reign of Zhou, once Emperor Xuan had risen in honor, Jing was posthumously enfeoffed as General-in-Chief of the Left Yaoqi Guards.

sentences.zh: 宣祖少驍勇，善騎射，事趙王王鎔，為鎔將五百騎援唐莊宗于河上有功。

translations.literal: In youth Emperor Xuan was fierce and brave, skilled at mounted archery; he served Prince Zhao Wang Rong and, leading five hundred horsemen for Rong to aid Tang Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Emperor Xuan was fierce and brave and skilled at mounted archery. He served Prince Zhao Wang Rong and, at the head of five hundred horsemen sent by Rong to aid Tang Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, won distinction.

sentences.zh: 莊宗愛其勇，留典禁軍。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong admired his courage and retained him to oversee the palace guards.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong admired his courage and kept him to command the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐中，討王景於鳳翔，會蜀兵來援，戰于陳倉。

translations.literal: In the Qianyou era of Han, campaigning against Wang Jing at Fengxiang, he encountered Shu troops coming to reinforce; they fought at Chencang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianyou era of Han, while campaigning against Wang Jing at Fengxiang, he met Shu reinforcements and fought them at Chencang.

sentences.zh: 始合，矢集左目，氣彌盛，奮擊大敗之，以功遷護聖都指揮使。

translations.literal: As the lines first clashed, arrows clustered in his left eye; his spirit grew fiercer still, and striking hard he inflicted a great defeat, and by merit was promoted to commander of the Protecting Sagely Command.
translations.idiomatic: When the lines first met, arrows struck his left eye, yet his fighting spirit only burned hotter. He struck hard and routed the enemy, and for this merit was promoted commander of the Protecting Sagely Command.

sentences.zh: 周廣順末，改鐵騎第一軍都指揮使，轉右廂都指揮，領岳州防禦使。

translations.literal: At the end of Guangshun of Zhou he was made commander of the first Iron Cavalry Army, then transferred to commander of the right wing and appointed defense commissioner of Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhou Guangshun he was made commander of the First Iron Cavalry Army, then transferred to commander of the right wing and appointed defense commissioner of Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 從征淮南，前軍却，吳人來乘，宣祖邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: On the Huainan campaign the vanguard fell back and Wu troops came to exploit it; Emperor Xuan intercepted and struck them, defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: On the Huainan campaign, when the vanguard fell back and Wu troops pressed the advantage, Emperor Xuan intercepted them and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 顯德三年，督軍平揚州，與世宗會壽春。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xiande he directed the army that pacified Yangzhou and joined Emperor Shizong at Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiande year three he directed the army that pacified Yangzhou and joined Emperor Shizong at Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 壽春賣餅家餅薄小，世宗怒，執十餘輩將誅之，宣祖固諫得釋。

translations.literal: At Shouchun a cake-seller's cakes were thin and small; Shizong was angry and seized more than ten men to execute them, but Emperor Xuan firmly remonstrated and they were released.
translations.idiomatic: At Shouchun a cake-seller's wares were thin and small. Shizong grew angry and seized more than ten people for execution, but Emperor Xuan remonstrated firmly and won their release.

sentences.zh: 累官檢校司徒、天水縣男，與太祖分典禁兵，一時榮之。

translations.literal: Rising through posts he became honorary Minister of Works and Baron of Tianshui, and together with Taizu he shared command of the palace guards—a glory of the age.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to honorary Minister of Works and Baron of Tianshui and, together with Taizu, shared command of the palace guards—to the envy of the age.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈武清軍節度使、太尉。

translations.literal: At his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as military commissioner of Wuqing and Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: At his death he was posthumously enfeoffed military commissioner of Wuqing and Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 太祖，宣祖仲子也，母杜氏。

translations.literal: Taizu was the second son of Emperor Xuan; his mother was the Lady Du.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu was Emperor Xuan's second son; his mother was Lady Du.

sentences.zh: 後唐天成二年，生於洛陽夾馬營，赤光繞室，異香經宿不散，體有金色，三日不變。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng of Later Tang he was born at the Jiamaying quarter in Luoyang; red light circled the room, a strange fragrance lingered a night and did not disperse, his body showed golden color, and for three days it did not change.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Later Tang Tiancheng he was born at the Jiamaying quarter in Luoyang. Red light circled the room, a strange fragrance lingered through the night, his body showed a golden hue, and for three days it did not fade.

sentences.zh: 既長，容貌雄偉，器度豁如，識者知其非常人。

translations.literal: When he had grown, his appearance was imposing and his bearing open; those who knew him saw that he was no ordinary man.
translations.idiomatic: When he had grown, his bearing was imposing and his manner open, and those who knew him saw he was no ordinary man.

sentences.zh: 學騎射，輒出人上，嘗試惡馬，不施銜勒，馬逸上城斜道，額觸門楣墜地，人以為首必碎，太祖徐起，更追馬騰上，一無所傷。

translations.literal: Studying mounted archery, he always surpassed others; once he tried a vicious horse without bit or bridle—the horse bolted up the slanting ramp of the city wall, his forehead struck the gate lintel and he fell to the ground; people thought his head must be shattered, but Taizu rose slowly, pursued the horse again and leapt upon it, and was wholly unhurt.
translations.idiomatic: In mounted archery he always surpassed others. Once he tried a vicious horse without bit or bridle; it bolted up the city ramp, struck the gate lintel with its forehead, and threw him down. Onlookers thought his skull must be shattered, but Taizu rose calmly, caught the horse again, and vaulted into the saddle unharmed.

sentences.zh: 又嘗與韓令坤博土室中，雀鬬戶外，因競起掩雀，而室隨壞。

translations.literal: Again, while gambling with Han Lingkun in an earthen chamber, sparrows fought outside the door; competing to rush out and catch them, the chamber collapsed with them.
translations.idiomatic: Once, gambling with Han Lingkun in an earthen room, he saw sparrows fighting outside and rushed out to catch them—whereupon the room collapsed behind them.

sentences.zh: 漢初，漫遊無所遇，舍襄陽僧寺，有老僧善術數，顧曰：「吾厚贐汝，北往則有遇矣。

translations.literal: Early in Han he wandered without meeting opportunity and lodged at a monk's temple in Xiangyang; an old monk skilled in numerology looked at him and said, "I shall richly reward you—go north and you will meet your chance."
translations.idiomatic: Early in Han he wandered without finding his chance and lodged at a temple in Xiangyang. An old monk skilled in divination looked at him and said, "I shall richly reward you—go north and you will meet your opportunity."

sentences.zh: 」會周祖以樞密使征李守真，應募居帳下。

translations.literal: Just then Zhou Taizu, as military affairs commissioner, was campaigning against Li Shouzhen; he volunteered for service and dwelt in his headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zhou Taizu, campaigning against Li Shouzhen as military affairs commissioner, took him on; he volunteered and served in his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 廣順初，補東西班行首，拜滑州副指揮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun he was made chief of the eastern and western classes and appointed deputy commander at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Guangshun he was appointed chief of the eastern and western classes and made deputy commander at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 世宗尹京，轉開封府馬直軍使。

translations.literal: When Shizong held the capital as prince, Taizu was transferred to commander of the mounted guard of the Kaifeng prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong governed the capital as heir, Taizu was made commander of the Kaifeng prefectural mounted guard.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，復典禁兵。

translations.literal: When Shizong ascended the throne, he again was put in charge of the palace guards.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne, Taizu again commanded the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 北漢來寇，世宗率師禦之，戰於高平。

translations.literal: Northern Han came raiding; Shizong led the army to meet them and fought at Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: When Northern Han invaded, Shizong led the army to meet them and fought at Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 將合，指揮樊愛能等先遁，軍危。

translations.literal: As the lines were about to engage, the commanders Fan Aineng and others fled first and the army was in peril.
translations.idiomatic: As battle was about to join, commanders such as Fan Aineng fled first and the army was in grave peril.

sentences.zh: 太祖麾同列馳馬衝其鋒，漢兵大潰。

translations.literal: Taizu waved his comrades to gallop and crash into their front; the Han army was utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu waved his comrades forward, charged the enemy line, and utterly routed the Han army.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻河東城，焚其門，左臂中流矢，世宗止之。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he attacked the Hedong city, burned its gate, and an arrow struck his left arm; Shizong halted him.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory, he attacked the Hedong city and burned its gate; an arrow struck his left arm and Shizong ordered him to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 還，拜殿前都虞候，領嚴州刺史。

translations.literal: On his return he was made vice commander of the Palace Front Command and concurrently prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed vice commander of the Palace Front Command and concurrently prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年春，從征淮南，首敗萬眾於渦口，斬兵馬都監何延錫等。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he followed the Huainan campaign, first defeating ten thousand men at Wokou and beheading the horse-and-army overseer He Yanxi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three he joined the Huainan campaign, first routing ten thousand men at Wokou and beheading the horse-and-army overseer He Yanxi and others.

sentences.zh: 南唐節度皇甫暉、姚鳳眾號十五萬，塞清流關，擊走之。

translations.literal: The Southern Tang military commissioners Huangfu Hui and Yao Feng, numbering their forces at one hundred fifty thousand, blocked Qingliu Pass; he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang commissioners Huangfu Hui and Yao Feng, claiming one hundred fifty thousand men, blocked Qingliu Pass; he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 追至城下，暉曰：「人各為其主，願成列以決勝負。

translations.literal: Pursuing to below the city, Hui said, "Each man serves his own lord—let us form ranks and decide victory by battle."
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to the walls, Hui said, "Each of us serves his own lord—let us form ranks and settle this by battle."

sentences.zh: 」太祖笑而許之。

translations.literal: Taizu smiled and assented.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu smiled and agreed.

sentences.zh: 暉整陣出，太祖擁馬項直入，手刃暉中腦，並姚鳳禽之。

translations.literal: Hui drew up his formation and came out; Taizu seized the horse's neck and charged straight in, with his own hand blade-striking Hui in the crown of the head, and together with Yao Feng captured them.
translations.idiomatic: Hui formed his ranks and advanced. Taizu seized his horse's neck and charged straight in, with his own hand struck Hui down through the crown, and captured both Hui and Feng.

sentences.zh: 宣祖率兵夜半至城下，傳呼開門，太祖曰：「父子固親，啟閉，王事也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan led troops at midnight to the foot of the city and called to open the gate; Taizu said, "Father and son are indeed kin, but opening and closing the gate is the king's business."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan brought troops at midnight to the gate and called for it to be opened. Taizu said, "Father and son are kin, but the gate is the king's affair."

sentences.zh: 」詰旦，乃得入。

translations.literal: At dawn he was only then admitted.
translations.idiomatic: Not until dawn was he admitted.

sentences.zh: 韓令坤平揚州，南唐來援，令坤議退，世宗命太祖率兵二千趨六合。

translations.literal: Han Lingkun pacified Yangzhou; Southern Tang came to reinforce, and Lingkun considered retreat. Shizong ordered Taizu to lead two thousand men to hurry to Liuhe.
translations.idiomatic: Han Lingkun pacified Yangzhou, but when Southern Tang reinforcements arrived he considered retreat. Shizong ordered Taizu to lead two thousand men to Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 太祖下令曰：「揚州兵敢有過六合者，斷其足。

translations.literal: Taizu issued an order: "Any Yangzhou soldier who passes Liuhe will have his feet cut off."
translations.idiomatic: Taizu ordered, "Any soldier from Yangzhou who goes beyond Liuhe will have his feet cut off."

sentences.zh: 」令坤始固守。

translations.literal: Only then did Lingkun hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did Lingkun stand firm.

sentences.zh: 太祖尋敗齊王景達於六合東，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: Taizu soon afterward defeated Prince Qi Jing Da east of Liuhe and beheaded more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu soon defeated Prince Qi Jing Da east of Liuhe and took more than ten thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 還，拜殿前都指揮使，尋拜定國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Returning, he received command of the Palace Front and soon was enfeoffed military commissioner of Dingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made commander of the Palace Front Command and soon after military commissioner of Dingguo.

sentences.zh: 四年春，從征壽春，拔連珠砦，遂下壽州。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he followed the campaign against Shouchun, captured the Lianzhu stockades, and then took Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year he joined the Shouchun campaign, captured the linked stockades, and then took Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 還，拜義成軍節度、檢校太保，仍殿前都指揮使。

translations.literal: On his return he was made military commissioner of Yicheng and honorary Grand Guardian, still commander of the Palace Front Command.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made military commissioner of Yicheng and honorary Grand Guardian while retaining command of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 冬，從征濠、泗，為前鋒。

translations.literal: In winter he followed the campaign against Hao and Si as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he served as vanguard on the Hao and Si campaign.

sentences.zh: 時南唐砦于十八里灘，世宗方議以橐駝濟師，而太祖獨躍馬截流先渡，麾下騎隨之，遂破其砦。

translations.literal: At that time Southern Tang had a stockade at the Eighteen-li Shoal; Shizong was just discussing crossing the army on camel-litter rafts, but Taizu alone leapt his horse across the current and crossed first, his mounted followers coming after, and so broke their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang had fortified the Eighteen-li Shoal. Shizong was debating a camel-litter crossing, but Taizu alone spurred his horse across first, his riders following, and broke the stockade.

sentences.zh: 因其戰艦乘勝攻泗州，下之。

translations.literal: Taking their war-ships he pressed the victory to attack Sizhou and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing their warships, he pressed the attack to Sizhou and captured it.

sentences.zh: 南唐屯清口，太祖從世宗翼淮東下，夜追至山陽，俘唐節度使陳承詔以獻，遂拔楚州。

translations.literal: Southern Tang encamped at Qingkou; Taizu followed Shizong down the Huai east, pursued by night to Shanyang, captured and presented the Tang military commissioner Chen Chengzhao, and then took Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Southern Tang held Qingkou, Taizu followed Shizong down the Huai, pursued by night to Shanyang, captured Tang commissioner Chen Chengzhao, and took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 進破唐人于迎鑾江口，直抵南岸，焚其營柵，又破之于瓜步，淮南平。

translations.literal: Advancing he broke the Tang men at the Yingluan River mouth, reached the south bank, burned their camps and stockades, and again defeated them at Guabu; Huainan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced, broke the Tang at the Yingluan ford, reached the south bank, burned their camps, defeated them again at Guabu, and Huainan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 唐主畏太祖威名，用間於世宗，遣使遺太祖書，饋白金三千兩，太祖悉輸之內府，間乃不行。

translations.literal: The Tang ruler feared Taizu's renown and used intrigue with Shizong; he sent envoys with a letter to Taizu, gifting three thousand taels of white gold. Taizu turned it all in to the inner treasury, and the intrigue failed.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang ruler, fearing Taizu's renown, tried intrigue with Shizong and sent envoys with a letter and three thousand taels of white gold. Taizu turned it all over to the imperial treasury, and the plot came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 五年，改忠武軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was made military commissioner of Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to military commissioner of Zhongwu.

sentences.zh: 六年，世宗北征，為水陸都部署。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Shizong campaigned north and made Taizu overall commander by land and water.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Shizong campaigned north, Taizu was made overall land-and-water commander.

sentences.zh: 及莫州，先至瓦橋關，降其守將姚內斌，戰卻數千騎，關南平。

translations.literal: At Mozhou he first reached Waqiao Pass, induced its defending general Yao Neibin to surrender, fought off several thousand horsemen, and the south of the pass was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: At Mozhou he reached Waqiao Pass first, won the surrender of its defender Yao Neibin, fought off several thousand horsemen, and pacified the region south of the pass.

sentences.zh: 世宗在道，閱四方文書，得韋囊，中有木三尺餘，題云「點檢作天子」，異之。

translations.literal: Shizong on the road reviewed documents from all quarters and obtained a leather pouch; in it was a piece of wood more than three feet long inscribed, "The inspector-in-chief will become Son of Heaven," and he marveled at it.
translations.idiomatic: On the road Shizong reviewed documents from the realm and found a leather pouch containing a three-foot board inscribed, "The inspector-in-chief will become Son of Heaven." He was astonished.

sentences.zh: 時張永德為點檢，世宗不豫，還京師，拜太祖檢校太傅、殿前都點檢，以代永德。

translations.literal: At that time Zhang Yongde was inspector-in-chief; Shizong was unwell and returned to the capital, appointing Taizu honorary Grand Tutor and Palace Front inspector-in-chief in Yongde's place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yongde then held the inspectorate. When Shizong fell ill and returned to the capital, he made Taizu honorary Grand Tutor and Palace Front inspector-in-chief in Yongde's stead.

sentences.zh: 恭帝即位，改歸德軍節度、檢校太尉。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gong took the throne, Taizu was made military commissioner of Guide and honorary Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gong succeeded, Taizu was made military commissioner of Guide and honorary Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 七年春，北漢結契丹入寇，命出師禦之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Northern Han allied with the Khitan to invade; he was ordered to take the field against them.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year Northern Han allied with the Khitan to invade, and he was ordered to take the field.

sentences.zh: 次陳橋驛，軍中知星者苗訓引門吏楚昭輔視日下復有一日，黑光摩盪者久之。

translations.literal: Halting at Chenqiao Post, an army star-gazer, Miao Xun, led the gate clerk Chu Zhaofu to view the sun and saw beneath it another sun, black light rubbing and churning for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: At Chenqiao Post an army astrologer, Miao Xun, had the gate clerk Chu Zhaofu look at the sun and saw a second sun beneath it, black light churning for a long while.

sentences.zh: 夜五鼓，軍士集驛門，宣言策點檢為天子，或止之，眾不聽。

translations.literal: At the fifth watch the soldiers gathered at the post gate, proclaiming their plan to install the inspector-in-chief as Son of Heaven; some tried to stop them, but the crowd would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth watch the troops gathered at the post gate, proclaiming that they would make the inspector-in-chief emperor. Some tried to stop them, but none would listen.

sentences.zh: 遲明，逼寢所，太宗入白，太祖起。

translations.literal: As dawn approached they pressed his sleeping quarters; the Prince of Jin entered to report, and Taizu rose.
translations.idiomatic: Near dawn they pressed his quarters. Prince of Jin came in to report, and Taizu rose.

sentences.zh: 諸校露刃列於庭，曰：「諸軍無主，願策太尉為天子。

translations.literal: The officers bared blades and stood in the courtyard, saying, "The army has no master—we wish to install the Grand Marshal as Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Officers with bared blades lined the courtyard. "The army has no master," they said. "We wish to make the Grand Marshal emperor."

sentences.zh: 」未及對，有以黃衣加太祖身，眾皆羅拜，呼萬歲，即掖太祖乘馬。

translations.literal: Before he could answer, someone put a yellow robe on Taizu; all bowed in a circle, shouted "Long live!" and at once helped Taizu mount a horse.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could reply, someone draped a yellow robe on him. All bowed, shouted "Long live!" and helped him onto a horse.

sentences.zh: 太祖攬轡謂諸將曰：「我有號令，爾能從乎？

translations.literal: Taizu took the reins and said to the generals, "I have commands—will you follow them?"
translations.idiomatic: Taizu gathered the reins and said, "I have commands—will you obey them?"

sentences.zh: 」皆下馬曰：「唯命。

translations.literal: All dismounted and said, "We await your orders alone."
translations.idiomatic: All dismounted. "Your orders alone," they said.

sentences.zh: 」太祖曰：「太后、主上，吾皆北面事之，汝輩不得驚犯；

translations.literal: Taizu said, "The Empress Dowager and the sovereign—I serve them both facing north; you must not frighten or harm them;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu said, "The Empress Dowager and the sovereign are my lieges—I face north to serve them. You must not frighten or harm them;

sentences.zh: 大臣皆我比肩，不得侵凌；

translations.literal: the great ministers are my peers—you must not insult them;
translations.idiomatic: the great ministers are my equals—you must not insult them;

sentences.zh: 朝廷府庫、士庶之家，不得侵掠。

translations.literal: the court treasuries and the homes of officials and commoners—you must not plunder them.
translations.idiomatic: the court treasuries and the homes of officials and commoners—you must not plunder.

sentences.zh: 用令有重賞，違即孥戮汝。

translations.literal: Whoever obeys this command will be richly rewarded; whoever violates it will have his whole clan put to death."
translations.idiomatic: Obey and you will be richly rewarded; violate it and your whole clan will be put to death."

sentences.zh: 」諸將皆載拜，肅隊以入。

translations.literal: The generals all bowed again in their armor and entered in disciplined ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The generals bowed again in armor and entered in formation.

sentences.zh: 副都指揮使韓通謀禦之，王彥昇遽殺通於其第。

translations.literal: Vice commander Han Tong plotted resistance; Wang Yansheng swiftly killed Tong at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commander Han Tong plotted resistance, but Wang Yansheng killed him at once in his house.

sentences.zh: 太祖進登明德門，令甲士歸營，乃退居公署。

translations.literal: Taizu advanced and ascended the Gate of Bright Virtue, ordered the armored soldiers back to camp, and then withdrew to the public office.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu entered the Gate of Bright Virtue, sent the soldiers back to camp, and withdrew to the government offices.

sentences.zh: 有頃，諸將擁宰相范質等至，太祖見之，嗚咽流涕曰：「違負天地，今至於此！

translations.literal: Before long the generals escorted the chief councillor Fan Zhi and others to him; seeing them, Taizu sobbed and said, "I have failed Heaven and Earth—now it has come to this!"
translations.idiomatic: Soon the generals brought chief councillor Fan Zhi and others. Taizu wept and said, "I have failed Heaven and Earth—how has it come to this!"

sentences.zh: 」質等未及對，列校羅彥瓌按劍厲聲謂質等曰：「我輩無主，今日須得天子。

translations.literal: Before they could reply, the officer Luo Yanhuan pressed his sword and said harshly to Zhi and the rest, "We have no master—today we must have a Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Before they could answer, officer Luo Yanhuan pressed his sword and cried to them, "We have no master—today we must have an emperor."

sentences.zh: 」質等相顧，計無從出，乃降階列拜。

translations.literal: Zhi and the others looked at one another; with no plan they stepped down the stairs and bowed in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: They looked at one another, found no escape, and came down to bow in ranks.

sentences.zh: 召文武百僚，至晡，班定。

translations.literal: He summoned the civil and military officials of all ranks; by late afternoon the court was set.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned civil and military officials of all ranks; by late afternoon the court was in order.

sentences.zh: 翰林承旨陶穀出周恭帝禪位制書於袖中，宣徽使引太祖就庭，北面拜受已，乃掖太祖升崇元殿，服衮冕，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor Tao Gu produced from his sleeve the abdication edict of Zhou Emperor Gong; the palace commissioner led Taizu to the courtyard, and facing north he bowed to receive it; then they helped Taizu ascend the Hall of Supreme Origin, don the imperial robes and cap, and take the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin expositor Tao Gu drew the abdication edict of Emperor Gong from his sleeve. Led to the courtyard, Taizu bowed north to receive it, then was helped to the Hall of Supreme Origin to don imperial robes and take the throne.

sentences.zh: 遷恭帝及符后于西宮，易其帝號曰鄭王，而尊符后為周太后。

translations.literal: He moved Emperor Gong and Empress Fu to the Western Palace, changed his imperial title to Prince of Zheng, and honored Empress Fu as Empress Dowager of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: He moved Emperor Gong and Empress Fu to the Western Palace, changed Gong's title to Prince of Zheng, and honored Fu as Zhou Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 建隆元年春正月乙巳，大赦，改元，定有天下之號曰宋。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jianlong, on the day yisi, he proclaimed a great amnesty, changed the reign title, and fixed the name of his possession of All Under Heaven as Song.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day in the first month of Jianlong year one he proclaimed a great amnesty, changed the reign title, and named his dynasty Song.

sentences.zh: 賜內外百官軍士爵賞，貶降者敘復，流配者釋放，父母該恩者封贈。

translations.literal: He bestowed ranks and rewards on inner and outer officials and soldiers; those demoted were restored, those exiled were released, and parents eligible for grace were enfeoffed posthumously.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded inner and outer officials and soldiers, restored the demoted, released the exiled, and posthumously enfeoffed parents eligible for grace.

sentences.zh: 遣使徧告郡國。

translations.literal: He sent envoys to announce it throughout the commanderies and states.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to announce the change throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔諭諸鎮將帥。

translations.literal: On Bingwu he issued an edict instructing the military commissioners and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he issued an edict to the military commissioners and commanders.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜書南唐。

translations.literal: On wushen he sent a letter to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he sent a letter to Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 贈韓通中書令，命以禮收葬。

translations.literal: Han Tong was posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Secretariat and ordered buried with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tong was posthumously made Director of the Secretariat and ordered buried with full honors.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣官告祭天地社稷。

translations.literal: On jiyou he dispatched officials to announce sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he sent officials to sacrifice to Heaven, Earth, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 復安州、華州、兗州為節度。

translations.literal: Anzhou, Huazhou, and Yanzhou were restored as military commissions.
translations.idiomatic: He restored Anzhou, Huazhou, and Yanzhou as military commissions.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，論翊戴功，以周義成軍節度使、殿前都指揮使石守信為歸德軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮使，江寧軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使高懷德為義成軍節度使、殿前副都點檢，武信軍節度使、侍衛親軍步軍都指揮使張令鐸為鎮安軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候，殿前都虞候王審琦為泰寧軍節度使、殿前都指揮使，虎捷右廂都虞候張光翰為江寧軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使，龍捷右廂都指揮使趙彥徽為武信軍節度使，餘領軍者並進爵。

translations.literal: On xinhai he assessed merit in aiding his enthronement: Zhou military commissioner of Yicheng and Palace Front commander Shi Shouxin was made military commissioner of Guide and deputy overall commander of the Palace guard horse-and-foot; Jiangning military commissioner and horse commander Gao Huaide was made military commissioner of Yicheng and vice inspector of the Palace Front; Wuxin military commissioner and foot commander Zhang Lingduo was made military commissioner of Zhen'an and overall vice commander of the Palace guard horse-and-foot; Palace Front vice commander Wang Shenqi was made military commissioner of Taining and Palace Front commander; Tiger Vanguard right wing vice commander Zhang Guanghan was made Jiangning military commissioner and horse commander; Dragon Vanguard right wing commander Zhao Yanhui was made Wuxin military commissioner; the rest who led armies were all advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he rewarded those who had aided his enthronement: Shi Shouxin, former Yicheng commissioner and Palace Front commander, became Guide commissioner and deputy overall commander of the Palace guard; Gao Huaide, Jiangning commissioner and horse commander, became Yicheng commissioner and vice Palace Front inspector; Zhang Lingduo, Wuxin commissioner and foot commander, became Zhen'an commissioner and overall vice commander of the guard; Wang Shenqi, Palace Front vice commander, became Taining commissioner and Palace Front commander; Zhang Guanghan, Tiger Vanguard right vice commander, became Jiangning commissioner and horse commander; Zhao Yanhui, Dragon Vanguard right commander, became Wuxin commissioner; others who led armies were all promoted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜宰相、樞密、諸軍校襲衣、犀玉帶、鞍馬有差。

translations.literal: On renzi he bestowed court robes, rhinoceros-and-jade belts, and saddled horses on the chief councillors, military commissioners, and army officers in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he gave court robes, rhinoceros-and-jade belts, and saddled horses to councillors, military commissioners, and army officers according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，放南唐降將周成等歸國。

translations.literal: On guichou he released the Southern Tang surrendered generals Zhou Cheng and others to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he sent Southern Tang surrendered generals including Zhou Cheng home.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使分振諸州。

translations.literal: On yimao he sent envoys separately to bring relief to the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he sent envoys to bring relief to the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命周宗正郭玘祀周陵廟，仍以時祭享。

translations.literal: On dingsi he ordered Zhou Director of the Imperial Clan Guo Qi to sacrifice at the Zhou imperial tombs, with seasonal offerings thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he ordered Zhou imperial clan director Guo Qi to sacrifice at the Zhou tombs, with seasonal rites thereafter.

sentences.zh: 己未，宰相表請以二月十六日為長春節。

translations.literal: On jiwei the chief councillors memorialized asking that the sixteenth day of the second month be made the Long Spring Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the chief councillors asked that the sixteenth day of the second month be made the Long Spring Festival.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以周天雄軍節度使、魏王符彥卿守太師，雄武軍節度使王景守太保、太原郡王，定難軍節度使、守太傅、西平王李彝殷守太尉，荊南節度使高保融守太傅，餘領節鎮者並進爵。

translations.literal: On guihai Zhou military commissioner of Tianxiong and Prince of Wei Fu Yanqing was kept as Grand Preceptor; Xiongwu military commissioner Wang Jing was kept as Grand Guardian and Prince of Taiyuan; Dingnan military commissioner, honorary Grand Tutor, and Prince of Xiping Li Yiyin was kept as Grand Marshal; Jingnan military commissioner Gao Baorong was kept as Grand Tutor; the rest holding military commissions were all advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Fu Yanqing, Zhou Tianxiong commissioner and Prince of Wei, was confirmed as Grand Preceptor; Wang Jing, Xiongwu commissioner, as Grand Guardian and Prince of Taiyuan; Li Yiyin, Dingnan commissioner, honorary Grand Tutor, and Prince of Xiping, as Grand Marshal; Gao Baorong, Jingnan commissioner, as Grand Tutor; other commissioners were all promoted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜皇弟殿前都虞候匡義名光義。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi he bestowed on his younger brother, Palace Front vice commander Kuangyi, the name Guangyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he granted his younger brother, Palace Front vice commander Kuangyi, the name Guangyi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the Imperial Ancestral Temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he established the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 鎮州郭崇報契丹與北漢軍皆遁。

translations.literal: Zhenzhou's Guo Chong reported that Khitan and Northern Han troops had all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chong of Zhenzhou reported that Khitan and Northern Han troops had all withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，尊母南陽郡夫人杜氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: On yihai he honored his mother, Lady Du of Nanyang Commandery, as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he honored his mother, Lady Du of Nanyang, as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 以周宰相范質依前守司徒、兼侍中，王溥守司空、兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，魏仁浦為尚書右僕射、兼中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，樞密使吳廷祚同中書門下二品。

translations.literal: Zhou chief councillor Fan Zhi was kept as honorary Minister of Works and concurrent Palace Attendant; Wang Pu was kept as honorary Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Joint Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat and Chancellery; Wei Renpu was made Vice Minister of the Right of the Ministry of Personnel, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Joint Manager of Affairs; Military Affairs Commissioner Wu Tingzuo was made of the second rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi, Zhou chief councillor, remained honorary Minister of Works and Palace Attendant; Wang Pu remained honorary Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Joint Manager of Affairs; Wei Renpu became Vice Minister of the Right of Personnel, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Joint Manager of Affairs; military affairs commissioner Wu Tingzuo was made of second rank in the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，長春節，賜群臣衣各一襲。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Long Spring Festival, he bestowed each minister with one suit of robes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Long Spring Festival, he gave each minister a suit of robes.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，改天下郡縣之犯御名、廟諱者。

translations.literal: On yisi in the third month he changed the names of commanderies and counties that bore imperial taboo or temple taboo.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the third month he changed place names that violated imperial or temple taboo.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，南唐主李景、吳越王錢俶遣使以御服、錦綺、金帛來賀。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Southern Tang ruler Li Jing and the King of Wuyue Qian Chu sent envoys bearing imperial regalia, brocades and silks, gold, and silks to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Jing of Southern Tang and Qian Chu of Wuyue sent envoys with imperial robes, brocades, gold, and silks to congratulate the court.

sentences.zh: 宿州火，遣使恤災。

translations.literal: Suzhou suffered fire; envoys were dispatched to comfort those afflicted by the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: After fire struck Suzhou, the emperor sent envoys to relieve the victims.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，定國運以火德王，色尚赤，臘用戌。

translations.literal: On renxu the dynasty's fortune was fixed on Fire as the Virtue to rule; red was esteemed as the color, and the La month was set to xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the state adopted Fire as its ruling Virtue, esteemed the color red, and assigned the La sacrifice to the xu branch.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命武勝軍節度使宋延渥等率舟師巡江徼。

translations.literal: On guihai Wusheng military commissioner Song Yanwo and others were ordered to lead naval forces in patrolling the river approaches.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Song Yanwo, commissioner of the Wusheng army, and others were ordered to patrol the river frontier with the fleet.

sentences.zh: 是春，均、房、商、洛鼠食苗。

translations.literal: That spring in Jun, Fang, Shang, and Luo prefectures rats ate the seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: That spring rats devoured the young crops in Jun, Fang, Shang, and Luo.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，竇儼上二舞十二樂曲名、樂章。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Dou Yi presented the names of the two dances and twelve music pieces and their librettos.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Dou Yi submitted the titles of the two court dances, the twelve musical pieces, and their texts.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On yiyou the emperor visited the Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he went to the Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 遣使分詣京城門，賜饑民粥。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent separately to the capital gates to bestow gruel on the famished.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to each capital gate to feed the hungry with gruel.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，浚蔡河。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Cai River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu work began to dredge the Cai River.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，昭義軍節度使李筠叛，遣歸德軍節度使石守信討之。

translations.literal: On guisi Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Yun rebelled; Guide military commissioner Shi Shouxin was sent to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Yun, commissioner of Zhaoyi, rebelled, and Shi Shouxin of Guide was dispatched to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day of the month, jihai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, the first of the month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣昭化軍節度使慕容延釗、彰德軍節度使王全斌將兵出東道，與守信會討李筠。

translations.literal: On gengzi Zhaohua military commissioner Murong Yanzhao and Zhangde military commissioner Wang Quanbin were sent to lead troops by the eastern route and join Shouxin in attacking Li Yun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Murong Yanzhao of Zhaohua and Wang Quanbin of Zhangde marched by the eastern route to join Shouxin against Li Yun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，竇儼上太廟舞曲名。

translations.literal: On renyin Dou Yi presented the names of the Imperial Ancestral Temple dance pieces.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Dou Yi submitted the titles of the ancestral temple dances.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，石守信敗李筠于長平。

translations.literal: On guimao Shi Shouxin defeated Li Yun at Changping.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Shi Shouxin routed Li Yun at Changping.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命諸道進討。

translations.literal: On jiachen orders were issued for all circuits to advance in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he ordered every circuit to join the offensive.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸魏仁浦第視疾。

translations.literal: On bingwu the emperor visited Wei Renpu's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he called at Wei Renpu's home to see him in his illness.

sentences.zh: 己酉，西京作周六廟成，遣官奉遷。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Zhou six temples completed in the Western Capital were finished; officials were dispatched to conduct the transfer of the tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Zhou ancestral temples in the Western Capital were completed, and officials were sent to move the spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔親征，以樞密使吳廷祚留守上都，都虞候光義為大內都點檢，命天平軍節度使韓令坤屯兵河陽。

translations.literal: On dingsi an edict announced that the emperor would lead the campaign in person; Grand Councilor Wu Tingzuo was left to guard the upper capital, Commandant-in-Chief Guangyi was made overall director of the inner palace, and Tianping military commissioner Han Lingkun was ordered to encamp at Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he announced a personal campaign, leaving Wu Tingzuo at the capital as regent, naming Guangyi overall director of the inner palace, and posting Han Lingkun of Tianping at Heyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，發京師。

translations.literal: On jiwei he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he marched out of the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，石守信、高懷德破筠眾于澤州，禽偽節度范守圖，殺北漢援兵之降者數千人，筠遁入澤州。

translations.literal: On dingmao Shi Shouxin and Gao Huaide smashed Yun's forces at Zezhou, captured the false commissioner Fan Shoutu, killed several thousand Northern Han reinforcements who had surrendered, and Yun fled into Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Shouxin and Gao Huaide broke Yun's army at Zezhou, took the rebel commissioner Fan Shoutu, put to death several thousand surrendered Northern Han auxiliaries, and Yun fled into the city.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，王師圍之。

translations.literal: On wuchen the imperial army besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the imperial forces laid siege to Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，有星赤色出心。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiyou, a red star emerged from the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, a red star appeared leaving the Heart.

sentences.zh: 辛未，拔澤州，筠赴火死，命埋胔骼。

translations.literal: On xinwei Zezhou was taken; Yun died by throwing himself into the fire, and orders were given to bury the corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zezhou fell; Yun threw himself into the flames and died, and the emperor ordered the dead buried.

sentences.zh: 釋河東相衛融，禁剽掠。

translations.literal: Wei Rong, counselor of Hedong, was released, and plunder was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He freed Wei Rong, counselor of Hedong, and forbade looting.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免澤州今年租。

translations.literal: On jiashen this year's land tax for Zezhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he exempted Zezhou from the year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 有星赤色出太微垣，歷上相。

translations.literal: A red star emerged from the Supreme Palace Enclosure and passed the Upper Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: A red star rose from the Supreme Palace Enclosure and crossed the Upper Minister.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伐上黨。

translations.literal: On yiyou an assault was made on Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the army attacked Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，筠子守節以城降，赦之。

translations.literal: On dinghai Yun's son Shoujie surrendered the city and was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yun's son Shoujie surrendered the city and received a pardon.

sentences.zh: 上如潞。

translations.literal: The emperor proceeded to Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went on to Lu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大赦，減死罪，免附潞三十里今年租，錄陣歿將校子孫，丁夫給復三年。

translations.literal: On xinmao a great amnesty was proclaimed; capital crimes were reduced, land tax within thirty li of Lu was remitted for the year, the sons and grandsons of officers who fell in battle were enrolled, and corvée laborers were exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he proclaimed a general amnesty, commuted capital sentences, remitted the year's tax within thirty li of Lu, enrolled the heirs of officers killed in battle, and gave corvée laborers three years' relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，永安軍節度使折德扆破北漢沙谷砦。

translations.literal: On jiawu Yong'an military commissioner Zhe Deyi captured the Northern Han fort at Shagu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhe Deyi of Yong'an stormed the Northern Han fort at Shagu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，上至自潞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on wushen, the emperor returned from Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, he returned from Lu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸范質第視疾。

translations.literal: On renzi he visited Fan Zhi's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he called at Fan Zhi's home to see him in his illness.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣工部侍郎艾穎拜嵩、慶陵。

translations.literal: On jiazi Vice Minister of Works Ai Ying was sent to perform sacrifices at the Song and Qing imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Vice Minister of Works Ai Ying was dispatched to sacrifice at the tombs of Song and Qing.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南唐進白金，賀平澤、潞。

translations.literal: On yichou Southern Tang presented white gold to congratulate the pacification of Ze and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Southern Tang sent white gold to congratulate the victories at Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，南唐進乘輿御服物。

translations.literal: On dingmao Southern Tang presented imperial carriages and regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Southern Tang sent imperial carriages and court regalia.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰朔，御崇元殿，行入閣儀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month, wuchen, he took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Origin and performed the ceremony of entering the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, the first of the month, he held court in the Hall of Supreme Origin and performed the entering-the-hall rite.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣郭玘饗周廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei Guo Qi was sent to offer sacrifices at the Zhou temples.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Guo Qi was sent to sacrifice at the Zhou temples.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復貝州為永清軍節度。

translations.literal: On renshen Beizhou was restored as the Yongqing military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Beizhou was again made the Yongqing military commission.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命宰相禱雨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the chief councillors were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he ordered the chief councillors to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以周武勝軍節度使侯章為太子太師。

translations.literal: On xinsi former Zhou Wusheng military commissioner Hou Zhang was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Hou Zhang, former Zhou commissioner of Wusheng, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以光義領泰寧軍節度，依前殿前都虞候。

translations.literal: On renwu Guangyi was made military commissioner of Taining while continuing as overall commandant of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Guangyi received Taining while retaining his post as overall Palace Front commandant.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立琅琊郡夫人王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jiashen Lady Wang of Langya commandery was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Lady Wang of Langya was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南唐進賀平澤潞金銀器、羅綺以千計。

translations.literal: On wuzi Southern Tang presented gold and silver vessels and silks and brocades numbering in the thousands to congratulate the pacification of Ze and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Southern Tang sent thousands of pieces of gold and silver ware and brocaded silks to celebrate the fall of Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，昭義軍節度使李繼勳焚北漢平遙縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renyin, Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Jixun burned Pingyao county in Northern Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, Li Jixun of Zhaoyi burned Pingyao in Northern Han territory.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，三佛齊國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On guimao envoys from Srivijaya came bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao envoys from Srivijaya arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，奉玉冊諡高祖曰文獻皇帝，廟號僖祖，高祖妣崔氏曰文懿皇后；

translations.literal: On bingwu jade registers were presented and the Great Ancestor was given the posthumous title Literary and Manifest Emperor with temple name Revered Ancestor; the Great Ancestor's consort Lady Cui was given the title Literary and Graceful Empress;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu jade memorials were offered: the Great Ancestor was styled Literary and Manifest Emperor, temple name Revered Ancestor, and his consort Lady Cui was named Literary and Graceful Empress;

sentences.zh: 曾祖曰惠元皇帝，廟號順祖，曾祖妣桑氏曰惠明皇后；

translations.literal: the great-grandfather was given the title Kind and Primordial Emperor with temple name Accomplished Ancestor, and the great-grandfather's consort Lady Sang was given the title Kind and Illuminating Empress;
translations.idiomatic: the great-grandfather became Kind and Primordial Emperor, temple name Accomplished Ancestor, and Lady Sang was named Kind and Illuminating Empress;

sentences.zh: 祖曰簡恭皇帝，廟號翼祖，祖妣劉氏曰簡穆皇后；

translations.literal: the grandfather was given the title Simple and Respectful Emperor with temple name Wing Ancestor, and the grandfather's consort Lady Liu was given the title Simple and Solemn Empress;
translations.idiomatic: the grandfather was styled Simple and Respectful Emperor, temple name Wing Ancestor, and Lady Liu was named Simple and Solemn Empress;

sentences.zh: 皇考曰武昭皇帝，廟號宣祖。

translations.literal: the imperial father was given the title Martial and Illustrious Emperor with temple name Proclaimed Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: the imperial father was styled Martial and Illustrious Emperor, temple name Proclaimed Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸宜春苑。

translations.literal: On jiyou the emperor visited Yichun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he went to Yichun Garden.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人趙逢坐從征避難，貶房州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat drafter Zhao Feng was punished for avoiding hardship on the campaign and was demoted to registrar of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng, a Palace Secretariat drafter, was demoted to registrar of Fang for shirking the campaign.

sentences.zh: 己未，淮南節度李重進以揚州叛，遣石守信等討之。

translations.literal: On jiwei Huainan military commissioner Li Chongjin rebelled at Yangzhou; Shi Shouxin and others were sent to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Chongjin of Huainan rebelled at Yangzhou, and Shi Shouxin and others were sent against him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，歸太原俘。

translations.literal: On jiazi captives from Taiyuan were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi prisoners taken at Taiyuan were released to return home.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，賜內外文武官冬衣有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, dingmao, winter garments were bestowed on civil and military officials inside and outside the court in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao, the first of the month, winter robes were distributed to officials at court and in the provinces according to rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，定縣為望、緊、上、中、下，令三年一注。

translations.literal: On renshen counties were classified as metropolitan, close, upper, middle, and lower, with revision ordered every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen counties were ranked as metropolitan, close, upper, middle, and lower, to be reassessed every three years.

sentences.zh: 壬午，河決厭次。

translations.literal: On renwu the Yellow River burst its banks at Yanci.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Yellow River broke through at Yanci.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，晉州兵馬鈐轄荊罕儒襲北漢汾州，死之；

translations.literal: On yiyou Jinzhou overseer of horse and army Jing Hanru raided Fenzhou in Northern Han and died in the action;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Jing Hanru, Jin's overseer of horse and army, raided Fenzhou in Northern Han and was killed;

sentences.zh: 龍捷指揮石進二十九人坐不救棄市。

translations.literal: Dragon Swift commander Shi Jin and twenty-eight others were executed in the market for failing to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Swift commander Shi Jin and twenty-eight men who had not come to his aid were executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔親征揚州，以都虞候光義為大內都部署，樞密使吳廷祚權上都留守。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict announced that the emperor would lead the campaign against Yangzhou in person; Commandant-in-Chief Guangyi was made overall director of the inner palace, and Grand Councilor Wu Tingzuo was made acting regent of the upper capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he announced a personal campaign against Yangzhou, naming Guangyi overall director of the inner palace and Wu Tingzuo acting regent at the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔諸道長貳有異政，眾舉留請立碑者，委參軍驗實以聞。

translations.literal: On wuzi an edict ordered that where circuit administrators and vice administrators had outstanding policies and the people petitioned to erect a stele in their honor, military aides should verify the facts and report.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he decreed that when a prefect or vice prefect won such praise that the people asked for a commemorative stele, staff officers must verify the claim before memorializing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，發京師。

translations.literal: On gengyin he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he marched out of the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，師傅揚州城，拔之，重進盡室自焚。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, the army reached Yangzhou, took the city, and Chongjin burned his entire household to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, the army invested Yangzhou, stormed it, and Chongjin burned himself with his whole family.

sentences.zh: 戊申，誅重進黨，揚州平。

translations.literal: On wushen Chongjin's partisans were executed, and Yangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Chongjin's followers were put to death and Yangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 命諸軍習戰艦于迎鑾，南唐主懼甚。

translations.literal: Orders were issued for the armies to drill on warships at Yingluan; the Southern Tang ruler was greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the armies to train on warships at Yingluan, and the Southern Tang ruler was seized with fear.

sentences.zh: 其臣杜著、薛良因詭跡來奔，帝疾其不忠，斬著下蜀市，配良廬州牙校。

translations.literal: His ministers Du Zhu and Xue Liang came over by feigning flight; the emperor despised their disloyalty, beheaded Zhu below the Shu market, and banished Liang to a Luzhou garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Du Zhu and Xue Liang defected by a ruse; disgusted at their treachery, he beheaded Zhu below the Shu market and sent Liang to serve as a Luzhou garrison clerk.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振揚州城中民人米一斛，十歲以下者半之。

translations.literal: On jiyou grain was distributed to the people within Yangzhou city, one hu per person, with half that amount for those under ten.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he rationed one hu of grain to each person in Yangzhou, half that for children under ten.

sentences.zh: 脅隸為軍者，賜衣屨遣還。

translations.literal: Those pressed into service as soldiers were given clothing and shoes and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Men dragooned into the army were clothed, shod, and sent back to their homes.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，給攻城役夫死者人絹三匹，復三年。

translations.literal: On gengxu three bolts of silk were given for each corvée laborer who died in the siege, and corvée was remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu families of corvée workers killed in the siege received three bolts of silk each, with three years' corvée relief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，南唐主遣使來犒師。

translations.literal: On yimao the Southern Tang ruler sent envoys to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Southern Tang ruler sent envoys to bring gifts to the troops.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣其子從鎰來朝。

translations.literal: On gengshen he sent his son Congyi to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he sent his son Congyi to the Song court.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，駕還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jisi, the imperial carriage returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jisi, the emperor turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上至自揚。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor returned from Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he arrived back from Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，泉州節度使留從效稱藩。

translations.literal: On xinmao Quanzhou military commissioner Liu Congxiao submitted to the dynasty as a vassal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Liu Congxiao of Quanzhou declared himself a vassal of the Song.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙申朔，上詣太后宮門稱慶。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the first day of the month, bingshen, the emperor went to the empress dowager's palace gate to offer New Year congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year two, spring, on bingshen, the first day of the first month, he went to the empress dowager's gate to offer New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 庚子，占城國王遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On gengzi the king of Champa dispatched envoys to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the king of Champa sent an embassy to the Song court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸造船務，觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On renyin he visited the shipyard to watch naval drill.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he inspected the shipyard and watched exercises on the water.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以揚州行宮為建隆寺。

translations.literal: On wushen the Yangzhou traveling palace was made the Jianlong Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Yangzhou palace was converted into Jianlong Temple.

sentences.zh: 太僕少卿王承哲坐舉官失實，責授殿中丞。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Imperial Stud Wang Chengzhe was punished for recommending an official on false grounds and was demoted to palace aide.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzhe, vice director of the Imperial Stud, was reduced to palace aide for a false recommendation.

sentences.zh: 壬子，商州鼠食苗，詔免賦。

translations.literal: On renzi in Shangzhou rats ate the seedlings, and an edict remitted the tax levy.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi rats ruined the crops in Shangzhou, and he remitted the taxes.

sentences.zh: 謂宰臣曰：「比命使度田，多邀功弊民，當慎其選，以見朕意。

translations.literal: He said to the chief councillors, "When of late I ordered envoys to survey fields, many sought merit to the people's harm. You must choose them carefully, to show my intent.
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief councillors, "Lately I have sent envoys to measure the fields, and many have courted merit at the people's expense. Choose them carefully—that is how you show what I intend."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，導蔡水入潁。

translations.literal: " On dingsi the Cai River was directed into the Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Cai River was channeled into the Ying.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣郭玘饗周廟。

translations.literal: On jiwei Guo Qi was sent to offer sacrifices at the Zhou temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Guo Qi was again sent to sacrifice at the Zhou temples.

sentences.zh: 靈武節度使馮繼業獻馬五百、橐駝百、野馬二。

translations.literal: Lingwu military commissioner Feng Jiye presented five hundred horses, one hundred camels, and two wild horses.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jiye of Lingwu presented five hundred horses, one hundred camels, and two wild horses.

sentences.zh: 甲子，澤州刺史張崇詁坐黨李重進棄市。

translations.literal: On jiazi Zezhou prefect Zhang Chonggu was executed in the market for joining Li Chongjin's faction.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Chonggu, prefect of Ze, was executed for siding with Li Chongjin.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，幸飛山營閱礮車。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin, he visited Flying Mountain Camp to review the catapult carts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin, he inspected the catapults at Flying Mountain Camp.

sentences.zh: 壬申，疏五丈河。

translations.literal: On renshen the Five-Zhang River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen work began to dredge the Five-Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有司奏進士合格者十一人。

translations.literal: On guiyou the relevant office memorialized that eleven candidates had passed the presented-scholar examination.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Ministry of Rites reported eleven men passed the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 荊南高保勖進黃金什器。

translations.literal: Jingnan's Gao Baoxu presented vessels of yellow gold.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Baoxu of Jingnan sent tribute vessels of yellow gold.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸城南，觀修水匱。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he visited the south of the city to inspect work on the water cisterns.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went south of the city to inspect the new water cisterns.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，南唐進長春節御衣、金帶及金銀器。

translations.literal: On dingchou Southern Tang presented Long Spring Festival robes, gold belts, and gold and silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Southern Tang sent birthday robes, gold belts, and gold and silver ware for the Long Spring Festival.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜天雄軍節度符彥卿粟。

translations.literal: On jimao grain was bestowed on Tianxiong military commissioner Fu Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he granted grain to Fu Yanqing of Tianxiong.

sentences.zh: 禁春夏捕魚射鳥。

translations.literal: Fishing and bird-hunting in spring and summer were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He banned fishing and fowling in spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 己丑，定竊盜律。

translations.literal: On jichou the statutes on theft were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he promulgated revised laws on theft.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，內酒坊火，酒工死者三十餘人，乘火為盜者五十人，擒斬三十八人，餘以宰臣諫獲免。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingshen, fire broke out at the inner wine bureau; more than thirty brewers died, and fifty men who looted amid the flames were seized—thirty-eight were beheaded, and the rest were spared on the chief councillors' remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen, the inner wine bureau burned; more than thirty brewers perished, and fifty looters were caught—thirty-eight were executed, the rest spared after the councillors protested.

sentences.zh: 酒坊使左承規、副使田處巖以酒工為盜，坐棄市。

translations.literal: Wine bureau commissioner Zuo Chenggui and vice commissioner Tian Chuyan were executed in the market on the charge that brewers had turned thieves.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Zuo Chenggui and vice commissioner Tian Chuyan of the wine bureau were executed for letting brewers run wild as thieves.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jisi, he visited the Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jisi, he went to the Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 謂侍臣曰：「沉湎非令儀，朕宴偶醉，恆悔之。

translations.literal: He said to his attendants, "Deep drinking is no proper conduct; when I am tipsy at a banquet I always regret it.
translations.idiomatic: He told his attendants, "Heavy drinking is unbecoming; when a feast leaves me drunk I always repent of it."

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，南唐進謝賜生辰金器、羅綺。

translations.literal: " On renchen Southern Tang presented gold vessels and silks in thanks for the birthday gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Southern Tang sent gold vessels and brocaded silks in thanks for the birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，金、商、房三州饑，振之。

translations.literal: On dingchou Jin, Shang, and Fang prefectures suffered famine, and relief was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou famine struck Jin, Shang, and Fang, and he ordered relief distributed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On guiwei he visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to Welcome Spring Garden for a banquet and archery contest.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day of the month, guisi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guisi, the first of the month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔郡國置前代帝王、賢臣陵塚戶。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict ordered the circuits and prefectures to establish custodial households for the tombs of former dynasties' emperors and worthy ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he ordered every circuit and prefecture to assign households to guard the graves of past emperors and worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 己酉，無棣男子趙遇詐稱皇弟，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiyou a man of Wudi, Zhao Yu, falsely claimed to be the emperor's younger brother and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhao Yu, a commoner from Wudi who had posed as the emperor's brother, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己未，商河縣令李瑤坐贓杖死，左讚善大夫申文緯坐失覺察除籍。

translations.literal: On jiwei Shanghe county magistrate Li Yao, convicted of corruption, was beaten to death with the staff; Left Honoring-the-Good Grand Master Shen Wenwei, convicted of failure to detect it, was struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Yao, magistrate of Shanghe, was flogged to death for graft, and Shen Wenwei, Left Honoring-the-Good Grand Master, was expelled from office for not catching it.

sentences.zh: 庚申，班私鍊貨易鹽及貨造酒麴律。

translations.literal: On gengshen the statutes on private smelting, trading salt, and trafficking in brewers' yeast were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he issued laws against private smelting, illicit salt trade, and trafficking in distilling yeast.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥朔，以皇太后疾，赦雜犯死罪已下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day of the month, guihai, because the Empress Dowager was ill, a general amnesty was granted for miscellaneous offenses down to capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai, the first of the month, the court pardoned miscellaneous crimes through capital offenses because the Empress Dowager lay ill.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，天狗墮西南。

translations.literal: On yichou a celestial dog fell in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a meteor streaked down in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，三佛齊國來獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingyin Srivijaya presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin envoys from Srivijaya arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以安邑、解兩池鹽給徐、宿、鄆、濟。

translations.literal: On dingchou salt from the Anyi and Jie pools was allotted to Xu, Su, Yan, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he assigned salt from the Anyi and Jie pools to Xu, Su, Yan, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，供奉官李繼昭坐盜賣官船棄市。

translations.literal: On gengyin Palace Attendant Li Jizhao, convicted of secretly selling government boats, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Jizhao, a palace attendant, was executed in the market for selling government boats on the sly.

sentences.zh: 詔諸道郵傳以軍卒遞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that postal relay on every circuit use army soldiers as couriers.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered every circuit's courier service to use soldiers as relay runners.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，皇太后崩於滋德殿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: the Empress Dowager expired in Zide Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the Empress Dowager died in Zide Hall.

sentences.zh: 己亥，群臣請聽政，從之。

translations.literal: On jihai the ministers asked that he hear government; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the ministers begged him to resume governance, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以太后喪，權停時享。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because of the Empress Dowager's mourning, seasonal sacrifices were temporarily suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, with the court in mourning for the Empress Dowager, seasonal temple offerings were suspended for the time being.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，見百官於紫宸殿門。

translations.literal: On xinchou he received the hundred officials at the gate of the Purple Forbidden Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he met the officials at the gate of the Purple Forbidden Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祈雨。

translations.literal: On renzi he prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he held a rain prayer.

sentences.zh: 庚申，釋服。

translations.literal: On gengshen he removed mourning garments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he laid aside mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，以皇太后殯，不受朝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, because the Empress Dowager's coffin was in state, he did not receive court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renxu, with the Empress Dowager's coffin still in the palace, he declined to hold audience.

sentences.zh: 辛未，晉州神山縣谷水泛出鐵，方圓二丈三尺，重七千斤。

translations.literal: On xinwei iron overflowed from the valley waters of Shenshan in Jinzhou—a mass twenty-three feet square, weighing seven thousand jin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a flood in the valleys of Shenshan, Jinzhou, washed out a block of iron twenty-three feet across and seven thousand jin in weight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以光義為開封府尹，光美行興元尹。

translations.literal: On renshen Guangyi was made prefect of Kaifeng, and Guangmei acted as prefect of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Guangyi was appointed prefect of Kaifeng and Guangmei acting prefect of Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，隴州進黃鸚鵡。

translations.literal: On jimao Longzhou presented a yellow parrot.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Longzhou sent up a yellow parrot.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰朔，不視朝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month, renchen, he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, the first of the month, he did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諸大辟送所屬州軍決判。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict ordered that all capital offenses be sent to the offender's circuit or army for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he decreed that capital cases be remitted to the convict's home circuit or garrison for sentencing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，南唐主李景死，子煜嗣，遣使請追尊帝號，從之。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Southern Tang ruler Li Jing died; his son Yu succeeded; envoys were sent requesting posthumous imperial honors for Jing, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Jing of Southern Tang died and his son Yu succeeded him; Yu's envoys asked that Jing receive a posthumous imperial title, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，執易定節度使、同平章事孫行友，削官勒歸私第。

translations.literal: On jiyou Yiding military commissioner and concurrent Grand Councilor Sun Xingyou was arrested, stripped of office, and compelled to return to his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Sun Xingyou, military commissioner of Yiding and concurrent Grand Councilor, was arrested, dismissed, and sent home under guard.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸崇夏寺，觀修三門。

translations.literal: On xinhai he visited Chongxia Temple and inspected work on the triple gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he went to Chongxia Temple to view repairs on the triple gate.

sentences.zh: 女直國遣使來朝獻。

translations.literal: The Jurchen state sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen envoys came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 大名府永濟主簿郭顗坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: Guo Yi, registrar of Yongji in Daming prefecture, was convicted of corruption and executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yi, registrar of Yongji in Daming, was executed in the market for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 庚申，周世宗實錄成。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Veritable Records of Emperor Shizong of Zhou were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Veritable Records of Zhou Emperor Shizong were finished.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌朔，不御殿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day of the month, renxu, he did not ascend the throne hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, the first of the month, he did not ascend the throne hall.

sentences.zh: 南唐遣使來進金銀、繒彩。

translations.literal: Southern Tang sent envoys presenting gold, silver, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent envoys with gifts of gold, silver, and brocaded silks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，契丹解利來降。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Khitan Xieli came over in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Khitan leader Xieli surrendered.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使高保勖遣其弟保寅來朝。

translations.literal: Jingnan military commissioner Gao Baoxu sent his younger brother Baoyin to court.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Baoxu of Jingnan sent his brother Baoyin to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣使南唐賻祭。

translations.literal: On wuzi envoys were dispatched to Southern Tang with funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he sent envoys to Southern Tang with condolence offerings for Li Jing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，南唐遣其臣韓熙載、田霖來會皇太后葬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, Southern Tang sent its ministers Han Xizai and Tian Lin to attend the Empress Dowager's burial.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi, Southern Tang sent Han Xizai and Tian Lin to take part in the Empress Dowager's funeral.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣樞密承旨王仁贍賜南唐禮物。

translations.literal: On bingshen Palace Secretariat commissioner Wang Renshan was sent to bestow ritual gifts on Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wang Renshan of the Palace Secretariat was sent to present ritual gifts to Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禁邊民盜塞外馬。

translations.literal: On wuxu frontier people were forbidden to steal horses beyond the border passes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he banned frontier subjects from rustling horses outside the passes.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，丹州大雨、雹。

translations.literal: On xinchou Danzhou had great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Danzhou was struck by heavy rain and hail.

sentences.zh: 丙午，葬明憲皇太后於安陵。

translations.literal: On bingwu Empress Dowager Mingxian was buried at An Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Empress Dowager Mingxian was interred at An Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉朔，不視朝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, xinyou, he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, the first of the month, he did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太后祔廟。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Empress Dowager was enshrined in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Empress Dowager's spirit tablet joined the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸相國寺，遂幸國子監。

translations.literal: On jisi he visited Xiangguo Temple and then visited the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he went to Xiangguo Temple and continued on to the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，沙州節度使曹元忠、瓜州團練使曹延繼等遣使獻玉鞍勒馬。

translations.literal: On guiyou Shazhou military commissioner Cao Yuanzhong, Guazhou regimental trainer Cao Yanji, and others sent envoys presenting horses with jade saddles and bridles.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Cao Yuanzhong of Shazhou, Cao Yanji of Guazhou, and others sent horses fitted with jade saddles and bridles.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，回鶻可汗景瓊遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renshen, the Uyghur qaghan Jing Qiong sent envoys with local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, Uyghur qaghan Jing Qiong sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙未，李繼勳敗北漢軍，俘遼州刺史傅廷彥、弟勳來獻。

translations.literal: On yiwei Li Jixun defeated the Northern Han army and presented as captives Liao prefect Fu Tingyan and his younger brother Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Jixun routed Northern Han and sent up the Liao prefect Fu Tingyan and his brother Xun as prisoners.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸新修河倉。

translations.literal: On xinchou he visited the newly repaired river granary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he inspected the newly repaired river granary.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，畋于近郊。

translations.literal: On gengxu he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he hunted just outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣使賜南唐、吳越馬、羊、橐駝有差。

translations.literal: On guichou envoys were sent to bestow horses, sheep, and camels on Southern Tang and Wuyue in varying numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he sent gifts of horses, sheep, and camels to Southern Tang and Wuyue in amounts suited to each court.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚申朔，以喪不受朝賀。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year, on the first day of the month, gengshen, because of mourning he did not receive congratulatory audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month of spring, on gengshen, the first of the month, he declined New Year's congratulations while still in mourning.

sentences.zh: 己已，淮南饑，振之。

translations.literal: On jisi Huainan suffered famine, and relief was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi famine struck Huainan, and he ordered relief grain distributed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to Welcome Spring Garden for a banquet and archery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，廣皇城。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Imperial City was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu work began to enlarge the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 詔郡國長吏勸民播種。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chief officials of circuits and prefectures to urge the people to sow seed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered local chiefs in every circuit and prefecture to press farmers to plant their fields.

sentences.zh: 丙子，瓜沙歸義節度使曹元忠獻馬。

translations.literal: On bingzi Guazha Returned-to-Righteousness military commissioner Cao Yuanzhong presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Cao Yuanzhong, commissioner of the Guazha Returned-to-Righteousness army, sent horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，女直國遣使只骨來獻。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Jurchen state sent the envoy Zhigu with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Jurchen envoys led by Zhigu arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔郡國不得役道路居民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that circuits and prefectures must not impress residents along the highways for labor.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade local governments to conscript people living along the post roads for corvée.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸國子監。

translations.literal: On guiwei he visited the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，復幸國子監，遂如迎春苑宴從官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingchen, he again visited the Directorate of Education and then went to Welcome Spring Garden to feast his attending officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen, he visited the Imperial Academy again, then entertained his attendants at Welcome Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔文班官舉堪為賓佐、令錄者各一人，不當者比事連坐。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict ordered civil-order officials each to recommend one man fit to serve as staff aide or as district magistrate or registrar; if the recommendation proved unworthy, the recommender would be punished by association according to the offense.
