translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he required each civil-order official to nominate one man fit for staff work or for a county post, with collective punishment if the nominee proved unfit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔自今百官朝對，須陳時政利病，無以觸諱為懼。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict ordered that from this time forward, when officials faced the throne in audience they must set forth what in current policy harmed or benefited the age, and must not fear to touch on taboo subjects.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he commanded that in palace audiences officials speak plainly of policy's harms and benefits, without fear of forbidden topics.

sentences.zh: 乙未，滑州節度使張建豐坐失火免官。

translations.literal: On yiwei Huazhou military commissioner Zhang Jianfeng, convicted of allowing a fire, was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhang Jianfeng of Huazhou was dismissed for a fire that broke out on his watch.

sentences.zh: 己亥，更定竊盜律。

translations.literal: On jihai the statutes on theft were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he promulgated a revised code on theft.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謂侍臣曰：「朕欲武臣盡讀書以通治道，何如？

translations.literal: On renwu the emperor said to his attending ministers, "I wish military officials all to read books so as to understand the way of governance—what do you think?
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he asked his ministers, "I want every military man to read so he may grasp how to govern—what say you?"

sentences.zh: 」左右不知所對。

translations.literal: " Those at his left and right did not know how to reply.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants had no answer ready.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，北漢寇潞、晉，守將擊走之。

translations.literal: On jiayin Northern Han raided Lu and Jin; the defending generals struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Northern Han raided Lu and Jin, but the garrison commanders beat them back.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午朔，厭次霣霜殺桑。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day of the month, wuwu, at Yanci frost fell and killed the mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu, the first of the month, late frost at Yanci destroyed the mulberries.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，三佛齊國遣使來獻。

translations.literal: On renxu Srivijaya sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu envoys from Srivijaya arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，禱雨。

translations.literal: On guihai he prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he held a rain prayer.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸太清觀，遂幸開封尹後園宴射。

translations.literal: On dingmao he visited the Abbey of Great Clarity, then visited the rear garden of the acting prefect of Kaifeng for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he went to the Abbey of Great Clarity, then feasted and shot arrows in the Kaifeng prefect's rear garden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大雨。

translations.literal: On jisi there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi a great rain fell.

sentences.zh: 詔申律文諭郡國，犯大辟者刑部審覆。

translations.literal: An edict set forth the statutes for the circuits and prefectures: for those who committed capital offenses, the Ministry of Justice was to review and confirm.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the penal code to every province with orders that capital sentences receive Ministry of Justice review.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣使賜南唐主生辰禮物。

translations.literal: On yihai envoys were sent to bestow birthday gifts on the Southern Tang ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he sent birthday gifts to the ruler of Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，女直國遣使來獻。

translations.literal: On dingchou the Jurchen state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Jurchen envoys came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命徙北漢降人於邢、洺。

translations.literal: On dinghai he ordered Northern Han captives resettled in Xing and Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he ordered captives from Northern Han moved to Xing and Ming.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，延州大雨雪，趙、衛二州旱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei, Yanzhou had great rain and snow; Zhao and Wei prefectures suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yiwei, Yanzhou was hit by driving rain and snow while Zhao and Wei withered in drought.

sentences.zh: 丙申，寧州大雨雪，溝洫冰。

translations.literal: On bingshen Ningzhou had great rain and snow, and the ditches and canals froze.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Ningzhou saw heavy rain and snow, and its irrigation ditches iced over.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸太清觀。

translations.literal: On wuxu he visited the Abbey of Great Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he went to the Abbey of Great Clarity.

sentences.zh: 庚子，回鶻阿督等來獻方物。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Uyghur Adu and others came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Uyghur leader Adu and his party arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，丹州雪二尺。

translations.literal: On renyin Danzhou had snow two feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin snow piled two feet deep in Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，贈兄光濟為邕王，弟光讚為夔王，追冊夫人賀氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On yisi his elder brother Guangji was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yong, his younger brother Guangzan as Prince of Kui, and Lady He was posthumously installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he enfeoffed his late brother Guangji as Prince of Yong and Guangzan as Prince of Kui, and raised Lady He to empress posthumously.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，幸相國寺禱雨，遂幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, he visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain, then visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, he prayed for rain at Xiangguo Temple, then feasted and shot arrows at Welcome Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，海州火。

translations.literal: On yihai Haizhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai fire broke out in Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 開太行運路。

translations.literal: The transport road through the Taihang range was opened.
translations.idiomatic: Work opened the Taihang transport route.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命使檢河北諸州旱。

translations.literal: On guiwei he ordered envoys to inspect drought in the Hebei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he sent commissioners to survey drought in the Hebei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔均戶役，敢蔽占者有罪。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict ordered corvée levies equalized by household; those who dared conceal or usurp obligations were guilty of crime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he decreed equal household corvée and criminal penalties for anyone who hid or shifted burdens.

sentences.zh: 復幸相國寺禱雨。

translations.literal: He again visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，廣大內。

translations.literal: On yiyou the inner palace precinct was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he ordered the inner palace enlarged.

sentences.zh: 齊、博、德、相、霸五州自春不雨，以旱減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: Qi, Bo, De, Xiang, and Ba prefectures had had no rain since spring; because of the drought he reduced his meals and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, Bo, De, Xiang, and Ba had not seen rain since spring; he ate sparingly and silenced the palace music.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，振宿州饑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao, relief was distributed to famine in Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, he sent relief grain to famine-stricken Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，吳廷祚以雄武軍節度使罷。

translations.literal: On guisi Wu Tingzuo was dismissed from his post as Victorious Martial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Wu Tingzuo was removed as commissioner of the Victorious Martial army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜酒國子監。

translations.literal: On yiwei wine was bestowed at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he granted wine to the scholars at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸太清觀。

translations.literal: On dingyou he visited the Abbey of Great Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to the Abbey of Great Clarity.

sentences.zh: 己亥，減京畿、河北死罪以下。

translations.literal: On jihai sentences below capital crime in the capital region and Hebei were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he commuted sentences short of death in the capital region and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，京師雨。

translations.literal: On renyin rain fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin rain at last fell on the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蕃部尚波于等爭採造務，以兵犯渭北，知秦州高防擊走之。

translations.literal: On renzi the Tibetan chieftain Shanboyu and others fought over the timber procurement office and invaded north of the Wei with troops; Qinzhou prefect Gao Fang struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Tibetan leader Shanboyu quarreled over the timber monopoly and marched on the north bank of the Wei; Gao Fang of Qinzhou routed him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On jiamao he visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiamao he went to Welcome Spring Garden for a banquet and archery.

sentences.zh: 黃陂縣有象自南來食稼。

translations.literal: In Huangpi county an elephant came from the south and ate the grain in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: An elephant wandered north into Huangpi and grazed on the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，南唐遣其臣翟如璧謝賜生辰禮，貢金銀、錦綺千萬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen, Southern Tang sent its minister Zhai Rubi to thank the court for the birthday gifts, presenting gold, silver, and brocades to the value of ten million.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengshen, Southern Tang sent Zhai Rubi to thank the court for the birthday gifts, with gold, silver, and brocades worth ten million cash.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，放南唐降卒弱者數千人歸國。

translations.literal: On renxu several thousand weak Southern Tang captives were released to return to their state.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he sent home several thousand infirm Southern Tang prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免舒州菰蒲新稅。

translations.literal: On yichou the new tax on wild rice and cattail-reed at Shuzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he abolished Shuzhou's new levy on wild rice and reed harvests.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，潞州大雨、雹。

translations.literal: On dingmao Luzhou had heavy rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Luzhou was struck by heavy rain and hail.

sentences.zh: 索內外軍不律者配沙門島。

translations.literal: Undisciplined soldiers in the inner and outer armies were sought out and assigned to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: He rounded up undisciplined troops throughout the palace and field armies and sent them to penal exile on Shamen Island.

sentences.zh: 己卯，北漢捉生指揮使路貴等來降。

translations.literal: On jimao Lu Gui and others, Northern Han captive-taking commanders, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Lu Gui and fellow officers of Northern Han's captive-raiding command surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣從臣十人檢河北旱。

translations.literal: On xinsi ten attending ministers were dispatched to inspect drought in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sent ten close advisers to survey the drought in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸未，兗、濟、德、磁、洺五州蝝。

translations.literal: On guimao locust nymphs appeared in Yan, Ji, De, Ci, and Ming prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao young locusts hatched across Yan, Ji, De, Ci, and Ming.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，蔡河務綱官王訓等四人坐以糠土雜軍糧，磔於市。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guisi, Wang Xun and three other transport grain officials of the Cai River office were convicted of mixing chaff and earth into army grain and were dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, Wang Xun and three fellow grain inspectors on the Cai River route were torn apart in the market for adulterating army rations with chaff and dirt.

sentences.zh: 乙未，用知制誥高錫言，諸行賂獲薦者許告訐，奴婢鄰親能告者賞。

translations.literal: On yiwei, following Drafting Drafter Gao Xi's memorial, those who had gained recommendation through bribery might be reported, and slaves, bondmaids, neighbors, and kin who reported would be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, acting on Gao Xi's advice, the court invited informers against officials who had bought their promotions and promised rewards to any slave, neighbor, or kinsman who came forward.

sentences.zh: 詔注諸道司法參軍皆以律疏試判。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that judicial adjutants of every circuit be examined in judgment using the code and its commentaries.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that every circuit's judicial aides pass a judgment examination based on the statutes and their glosses.

sentences.zh: 詔尚書吏部舉書判拔萃科。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel to hold the Outstanding Judgment and Writing examination.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Ministry of Personnel to convene the Outstanding Judgment and Writing recruitment.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，吐蕃尚波于等歸伏羌縣地。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu, the Tibetan chieftain Shanboyu and others returned Fuxiang county territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, the Tibetan leader Shanboyu restored the lands of Fuxiang county.

sentences.zh: 壬申，修武成王廟。

translations.literal: On renshen the temple of Marquis Wu was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen work began on the temple of Marquis Wu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，占城國來獻。

translations.literal: On bingzi Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi envoys from Champa arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 禁伐桑棗。

translations.literal: Cutting mulberry and jujube trees was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade the felling of mulberry and jujube trees.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，賜百官冬服有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yiyou, the first of the month, winter garments were bestowed on the hundred officials in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yiyou, the first of the month, he distributed winter robes to the officials according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸太清觀，遂幸造船務，觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On bingxu he visited the Abbey of Great Clarity, then the shipyard office to watch naval drill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he went to the Abbey of Great Clarity and then to the imperial shipyard to review exercises at sea.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸岳臺，命諸軍習騎射，復幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On jihai he visited Yue Platform, ordered the armies to practice mounted archery, then visited Jade Ford Garden again.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he inspected archery at Yue Platform, put the armies through mounted drill, and returned to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以樞密副使趙普為樞密使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhao Pu was made commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhao Pu was promoted from vice to full commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On xinhai he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he hunted just outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，禁奉使請托。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guihai, envoys' solicitation of favors was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai, he banned court envoys from trading on their missions for private gain.

sentences.zh: 縣令考課以戶口增減為黜陟。

translations.literal: County magistrates' evaluations used increase or decrease in registered households as the criterion for promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates would rise or fall in rank according to whether their counties gained or lost households on the registers.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，南唐遣其臣顧彝來朝。

translations.literal: On bingyin Southern Tang sent its minister Gu Yi to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Gu Yi of Southern Tang came to audience.

sentences.zh: 丙子，三佛齊國遣使李麗林等來獻，高麗國遣李興祐等來朝。

translations.literal: On bingzi Srivijaya sent the envoy Li Lilin and others with tribute, and Goryeo sent Li Xingyou and others to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Lilin arrived from Srivijaya with tribute, and Li Xingyou led a mission from Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 己卯，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On jimao he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he hunted again near the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜南唐建隆四年曆。

translations.literal: On renwu the Jianlong year-four calendar was granted to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he sent Southern Tang the court calendar for the fourth year of Jianlong.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，詔縣置尉一員，理盜訟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, an edict ordered each county to appoint one sheriff to handle theft and litigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, he required every county to seat a sheriff for robberies and civil suits.

sentences.zh: 置弓手，視縣戶為差。

translations.literal: Archer militia were established, apportioned according to the county's households.
translations.idiomatic: He also raised bowmen militia, with quotas set by each county's registered households.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，蒲、晉、慈、隰、相、衛六州饑，振之。

translations.literal: On wuxu Pu, Jin, Ci, Xi, Xiang, and Wei—six prefectures—suffered famine and were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu famine gripped Pu, Jin, Ci, Xi, Xiang, and Wei, and he opened relief granaries there.

sentences.zh: 庚子，班捕盜令。

translations.literal: On gengzi the bandit-catching ordinance was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he issued the new ordinance against banditry.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，衡州刺史張文表叛。

translations.literal: On jiachen Zhang Wenbiao, prefect of Hengzhou, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Wenbiao, the prefect of Hengzhou, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周鄭王出居房州。

translations.literal: That year the Zhou King of Zheng was sent out to reside in Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year the deposed Zhou King of Zheng was banished to live in Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年春正月甲寅朔，不御殿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiande, spring, first month, on jiayin, the first of the month, he did not ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande year one, first month of spring, on jiayin, the first of the month, he declined the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，發關西鄉兵赴慶州。

translations.literal: On yimao militia from west of the pass were mobilized for Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he called up Guanxi militia and marched them to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，修畿內河隄。

translations.literal: On dingsi the river dikes within the capital region were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi work crews repaired the river levees around the capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣使賜南唐吳越馬、橐駝、羊有差。

translations.literal: On jiwei envoys were dispatched to grant horses, camels, and sheep to Southern Tang and Wuyue in varying numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he sent gifts of horses, camels, and sheep to Southern Tang and Wuyue in amounts suited to each court.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣山南東道節度使慕容延釗率十州兵以討張文表。

translations.literal: On gengshen Murong Yanqiu, military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, was sent at the head of troops from ten prefectures to campaign against Zhang Wenbiao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Murong Yanqiu of Shannan East took ten prefectures' troops south to crush Zhang Wenbiao.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸造船務，觀造戰船。

translations.literal: On yichou he visited the shipyard office to watch warships being built.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he toured the shipyard to watch warships take shape.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔荊南發水卒三千應延釗于潭。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict ordered Jingnan to dispatch three thousand naval troops to join Yanqiu at Tan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he ordered Jingnan to send three thousand sailors upriver to reinforce Murong Yanqiu at Tan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，女直國遣使來獻。

translations.literal: On jimao the Jurchen state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Jurchen envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，周保權將楊師璠梟文表於朗陵市。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renchen, Yang Shijiao, general of Zhou Baquan, displayed Zhang Wenbiao's head in the market at Langling.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, Yang Shijiao of Zhou Baquan's army exposed Zhang Wenbiao's head in the Langling market.

sentences.zh: 甲午，慕容延釗入荊南，高繼沖請歸朝，得州三，縣十七。

translations.literal: On jiawu Murong Yanqiu entered Jingnan; Gao Jichong petitioned to surrender to the court; three prefectures and seventeen counties were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Murong Yanqiu marched into Jingnan, where Gao Jichong offered submission, yielding three prefectures and seventeen counties.

sentences.zh: 乙未，克潭州。

translations.literal: On yiwei Tanzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the army captured Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，澶、滑、衛、魏、晉、絳、蒲、孟八州饑，命發廩振之。

translations.literal: On xinhai eight prefectures—Chen, Hua, Wei, Wei, Jin, Jiang, Pu, and Meng—suffered famine; orders went out to open the granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai famine spread through Chen, Hua, Wei, Wei, Jin, Jiang, Pu, and Meng, and he ordered the state granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，幸金鳳園習射，七發皆中。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinwei, he visited Golden Phoenix Garden for archery practice; all seven shots hit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, he shot seven arrows at Golden Phoenix Garden and hit with every one.

sentences.zh: 符彥卿等進馬稱賀，乃遍賜從臣名馬、銀器有差。

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing and others presented horses to offer congratulations; then famous horses and silver vessels were bestowed on the attending ministers in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing and his fellows brought horses to congratulate him, and he in turn gave his attendants prized horses and silverware according to rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，高繼沖籍其錢帛芻粟來上。

translations.literal: On renshen Gao Jichong registered his cash, silks, fodder, and grain and sent them up.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Gao Jichong turned his treasury, stores, and grain over to the court.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，班新定律。

translations.literal: On guiyou the newly revised statutes were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he proclaimed the revised code.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，慕容延釗破三江口，下岳州，克復朗州，湖南平。

translations.literal: On wuyin Murong Yanqiu broke the enemy at Three Rivers Mouth, descended on Yuezhou, recovered Langzhou—Hunan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Murong Yanqiu smashed the foe at Three Rivers Mouth, took Yuezhou, and recovered Langzhou, bringing Hunan under control.

sentences.zh: 得州十四，監一，縣六十六。

translations.literal: Fourteen prefectures, one supervisory commission, and sixty-six counties were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The conquest added fourteen prefectures, one superintendency, and sixty-six counties.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，旱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month a drought set in.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遍禱京城祠廟，夕雨。

translations.literal: On jiashen prayers were offered at every shrine and temple in the capital; rain fell that evening.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he prayed at shrines throughout the capital, and rain came by nightfall.

sentences.zh: 減荊南朗州、潭州管內死罪一等，鹵掠者給主。

translations.literal: Death sentences within Lang and Tan prefectures under Jingnan were reduced one grade, and plunderers were made to restore goods to their owners.
translations.idiomatic: He commuted capital sentences by one grade in Lang and Tan under Jingnan and ordered looters to return what they had taken.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣使祭南岳。

translations.literal: On yiyou envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Southern Marchmount.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he sent envoys to offer sacrifice at Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸國子監，遂幸武成王廟，宴射玉津園。

translations.literal: On dinghai he visited the Directorate of Education, then visited the Temple of King Wu Cheng, and feasted with archery at Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he went to the Imperial Academy, then to the Temple of King Wu Cheng, and ended the day feasting and shooting at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，出內錢募諸軍子弟鑿習戰池。

translations.literal: On gengyin palace funds were issued to recruit sons of army families to excavate a drill pool for warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he spent palace funds to enlist soldiers' sons to dig a combat training pool.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，建隆應天曆成，御製序。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Jianlong Response-to-Heaven calendar was completed, and the emperor composed its preface.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the new Jianlong calendar was finished, with a preface in the emperor's own hand.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賞湖南立功將士。

translations.literal: On renchen officers and men who had won merit in Hunan were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he rewarded the generals and troops who had conquered Hunan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On guisi he visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he went to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兵部郎中曹匪躬棄市，海陵、鹽城屯田副使張藹除名，並坐不法。

translations.literal: On bingshen Bureau of Military Affairs director Cao Feigong was executed in the market, and Hailing and Yancheng deputy commissioners of garrison fields Zhang Ai was struck from the registers—both convicted of unlawful conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Cao Feigong of the Bureau of Military Affairs was put to death in the market and Zhang Ai, deputy commissioner of the Hailing and Yancheng garrison fields, was expelled from office, both for corruption.

sentences.zh: 庚子，荊南節度使高繼沖進助宴金銀、羅紈、柱衣、屏風等物。

translations.literal: On gengzi Jingnan military commissioner Gao Jichong presented gold and silver, brocades and silks, pillar vestments, screens, and other goods to assist the court banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Gao Jichong of Jingnan sent gold and silver, silks, ceremonial robes, screens, and other gifts for the palace feast.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，辰、錦、敘等州歸順。

translations.literal: On guimao Chen, Jin, Xu, and other prefectures submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Chen, Jin, Xu, and neighboring prefectures came over to the Song.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔疏鑿三門。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict ordered dredging and opening of the Three Gates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he ordered the Yellow River's Three Gates cleared and cut open.

sentences.zh: 禁涇、原、邠、慶等州補蕃人為邊鎮將。

translations.literal: It was forbidden in Jing, Yuan, Bin, Qing, and other prefectures to appoint Fan tribesmen as frontier garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: He barred Jing, Yuan, Bin, Qing, and the other northwestern prefectures from naming tribal men as frontier commanders.

sentences.zh: 夏西平王李彝興獻犛牛一。

translations.literal: Xiping King Li Yixing of Xia presented one yak.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yixing, the Tangut king of Xia, sent a yak as tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸玉津園，閱諸軍騎射。

translations.literal: On yisi he visited Jade Ford Garden and reviewed mounted archery among the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he went to Jade Ford Garden to watch the guards ride and shoot.

sentences.zh: 丙午，免湖南茶稅，禁峽州鹽井。

translations.literal: On bingwu the tea tax in Hunan was remitted, and salt wells in Xia prefecture were closed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he abolished the tea tax in Hunan and shut the salt wells of Xia prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，貸澶州民種食。

translations.literal: On xinhai seed grain was lent to the people of Duan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he issued seed grain on loan to farmers in Duanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，禱雨京城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the new-moon day renzi, rain prayers were held in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, the first of the month, he held a rain prayer in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使禱雨嶽瀆。

translations.literal: On jiayin envoys were sent to pray for rain at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he dispatched envoys to pray for rain at the sacred mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣大內。

translations.literal: On yichou the inner palace was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou work began to enlarge the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，給荊南管內符印。

translations.literal: On gengwu talismans and seals were issued within Jingnan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he granted official seals and credentials throughout Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On guiyou he visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he went to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，免潭州諸縣無名配斂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, unnamed levies in Tan prefecture's counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, he abolished illegal surcharges in the counties of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，暑，罷營造，賜工匠衫履。

translations.literal: On renchen, in the summer heat, construction was halted and artisans were given tunics and shoes.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, with the heat at its height, he suspended building works and gave the laborers tunics and shoes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔：荊南兵願歸農者聽。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict stated: Jingnan soldiers who wished to return to farming were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he decreed that Jingnan troops who wished to take up farming might be discharged to do so.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曆代帝王三年一饗，立漢光武、唐太宗廟。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict ordered that emperors of past dynasties receive sacrifice once every three years, and temples were established to Han Guangwu and Tang Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he decreed triennial sacrifices to past emperors and founded temples to Guangwu of Han and Taizong of Tang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，澶、濮、曹、絳蝗，命以牢祭。

translations.literal: On jihai locusts struck Duan, Pu, Cao, and Jiang; victims were ordered offered victims of the pen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai locusts ravaged Duan, Pu, Cao, and Jiang, and he ordered full victims sacrificed to appease heaven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，百官三上表請舉樂，從之。

translations.literal: On gengzi the hundred officials thrice memorialized requesting court music; the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the ministers submitted three memorials begging for court music, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 減左右仗千牛員。

translations.literal: The complement of the Left and Right Offices of the Thousand-Ox was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He cut the rolls of the palace's Thousand-Ox guards.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨。

translations.literal: On bingwu rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu rain at last fell.

sentences.zh: 詔蜡祀，廟、社皆用戌臘一日。

translations.literal: An edict on the La sacrifice ordered that temple and altar rites alike use the xu day of the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: He ruled that state and altar sacrifices at year's end should both fall on the xu day of the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命習水戰於新池。

translations.literal: On jiyou naval warfare was ordered drilled on the new pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he ordered naval drills on the new training pool.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，定州縣所置雜職、承符、廳子等名數。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the new-moon day xinhai, the quotas for miscellaneous clerks, credential bearers, and hall attendants in prefectures and counties were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinhai, the first of the month, he set head counts for county and prefectural clerks, runners, and hall servants.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以湖湘歿王事靳彥朗男承勳等三十人補殿直。

translations.literal: On jiayin thirty men including Jin Yanslang's son Chengxun, who had died in service on the lakes and Xiang, were appointed palace attendants of the direct class.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he commissioned thirty men, including Chengxun, son of Jin Yanslang, who had fallen in the Hunan campaign, as inner-palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸新池，賜役夫錢，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On bingchen he visited the new pool, bestowed cash on the laborers, and then visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he inspected the new pool, paid the work crews, and went on to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安國軍節度使王全斌等率兵入太原境，以俘來獻，給錢米以釋之。

translations.literal: On dingsi Anguo military commissioner Wang Quanbin and others led troops into Taiyuan territory, presented captives, and were given cash and grain to release them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wang Quanbin of Anguo marched into Northern Han territory, sent in prisoners, and received cash and grain to send them home.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔民有疾而親屬遺去者罪之。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict made it a crime for kin to abandon a sick relative.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he outlawed abandoning sick parents or kin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，湖南疫，賜行營將校藥。

translations.literal: On guihai plague struck Hunan, and medicine was granted to officers in the field army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai epidemic disease broke out in Hunan, and he sent medicine to the campaigning generals.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸武成王廟，遂幸新池，觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On dingmao he visited the Temple of King Wu Cheng, then visited the new pool and watched naval warfare drills.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he went to the Temple of King Wu Cheng, then to the new pool to watch the fleet train.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朗州賊將汪端寇州城，都監尹重睿擊走之。

translations.literal: On jisi Langzhou bandit commander Wang Duan raided the prefectural city; garrison commander Yin Chongrui struck and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wang Duan, a rebel leader in Langzhou, attacked the city; Yin Chongrui, the local commander, beat him back.

sentences.zh: 詔免荊南管內夏稅之半。

translations.literal: An edict remitted half the summer tax within Jingnan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: He cut the summer tax in Jingnan by half.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，釋周保權罪。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zhou Baoquan's offenses were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he pardoned Zhou Baoquan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔繕朗州城，免其管內夏稅。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict ordered repairs on Langzhou's walls and remitted the summer tax within its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he ordered Langzhou's walls rebuilt and exempted its summer tax.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，分命近臣禱雨。

translations.literal: On dingchou close ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he sent favored courtiers out in separate parties to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己卯，班重定刑統等書。

translations.literal: On jimao the court presented the newly revised Penal Code and related works.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the revised Penal Code and companion statutes were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，殿前都虞候張瓊以陵侮軍校史珪、石漢卿等，為所誣譖，下吏，瓊自殺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renwu, Palace Front commander Zhang Qiong, for having insulted army officers Shi Gui, Shi Hanqing, and others, was slandered by them, cast into prison, and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu Zhang Qiong, commander of the Palace Front, was framed by officers Shi Gui and Shi Hanqing after bullying them; thrown into prison, he took his own life.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣給事中劉載朝拜安陵。

translations.literal: On bingxu Supervising Secretary Liu Zai was sent to perform rites at Anling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he dispatched Liu Zai, a supervising secretary, to worship at Anling.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王全斌攻北漢樂平縣，降之。

translations.literal: On dinghai Wang Quanbin attacked Leping county in Northern Han and reduced it.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wang Quanbin stormed Leping in Northern Han and took the county.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以樂平縣為平晉軍，降卒千八百人為效順軍，人賜錢帛。

translations.literal: On xinmao Leping county was made Pingjin Army; the thousand eight hundred surrendered troops were made the Effect-Submission Army, and each man was given cash and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Leping was renamed Pingjin command; its eighteen hundred prisoners were enrolled as the Loyal Submission Army, each man rewarded with cash and cloth.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔九經舉人下第者再試。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict ordered candidates in the Nine Classics examination who had failed to sit for a second trial.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he allowed candidates who had failed the Nine Classics exam to try again.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，女直國遣使獻名馬。

translations.literal: On guisi the Jurchen state sent envoys presenting famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jurchen envoys arrived with famous horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 蠲登州沙門島民稅，令專治船渡馬。

translations.literal: The tax on the people of Monk's Gate Island in Dengzhou was remitted, and they were ordered to devote themselves solely to ferrying horses by boat.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted taxes on Monk's Gate Island in Dengzhou and ordered the islanders to ferry horses across the strait.

sentences.zh: 丙申，北漢靜陽十八砦首領來降。

translations.literal: On bingshen the chieftains of the eighteen forts of Jingyang in Northern Han came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the chiefs of Northern Han's eighteen Jingyang forts submitted.

sentences.zh: 泉州陳洪進遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: Chen Hongjin of Quanzhou sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongjin of Quanzhou sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 齊州河決。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks in Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through its banks in Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 京師雨。

translations.literal: Rain fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell on the capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，契丹幽州岐溝關使柴廷翰等來降。

translations.literal: On jihai Chai Tinghan, commissioner of Qigou Pass in Liao's Youzhou, and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Chai Tinghan, Liao commissioner at Qigou Pass in Youzhou, and others defected.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宰相質率百官上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On guimao Chancellor Zhi led the hundred officials in offering a honorific title; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Chancellor Fan Zhi led the officials in offering a honorific title, which he declined.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，三上表請，從之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, they submitted memorials three times begging leave; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin, after three memorials they begged again, and he assented.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宴廣政殿，始用樂。

translations.literal: On bingyin he feasted at the Hall of Broad Governance and for the first time used music.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he held a feast in the Hall of Broad Governance and for the first time had music performed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，責宣徽南院使兼樞密副使李處耘為淄州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Southern Inner Court commissioner and Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs Li Chuchun was demoted to prefect of Zi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Chuchun, commissioner of the Southern Inner Court and deputy commissioner of military affairs, was demoted to prefect of Zi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，女直國遣使獻海東青名鷹。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Jurchen state sent envoys presenting famous gyrfalcons from the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Jurchen envoys brought famed gyrfalcons from the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 丙子，禁朝臣公薦貢舉人。

translations.literal: On bingzi court officials were forbidden to recommend examination candidates in public.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he forbade court officials to recommend examination candidates openly.

sentences.zh: 賜南唐羊萬口。

translations.literal: Ten thousand sheep were bestowed on Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Southern Tang ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 磔汪端於朗州。

translations.literal: Wang Duan was dismembered at Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Duan was executed by dismemberment at Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，北漢引契丹兵攻平晉，遣洺州防禦使郭進等救之。

translations.literal: On wuyin Northern Han led Liao troops to attack Pingjin; Mingzhou defense commissioner Guo Jin and others were sent to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Northern Han brought Liao troops against Pingjin, and Guo Jin of Mingzhou and others were dispatched to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，詔州縣徵科置簿籍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengchen, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to keep ledgers for tax collection.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen, he ordered every prefecture and county to keep books for tax levies.

sentences.zh: 己亥，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On jihai he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，吳越國王進郊祀禮金銀、珠器、犀象、香藥皆萬計。

translations.literal: On dingwei the king of Wuyue presented gold, silver, pearls, rhinoceros horn, ivory, and aromatics for the suburban sacrifice, each counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the king of Wuyue sent suburban-sacrifice gifts of gold, silver, pearls, rhinoceros horn, ivory, and aromatics in vast quantities.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，荊南節度使高繼沖進郊祀銀萬兩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao, Jingnan military commissioner Gao Jichong presented ten thousand taels of silver for the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao, Gao Jichong of Jingnan sent ten thousand taels of silver for the suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 甲子，有事南郊，大赦，改元乾德。

translations.literal: On jiazi he performed the southern suburban sacrifice, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the era name to Qiande.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he offered at the southern suburb, proclaimed a general amnesty, and adopted the era name Qiande.

sentences.zh: 百官奉玉冊上尊號曰應天廣運仁聖文武至德皇帝。

translations.literal: The hundred officials presented on jade tablets a honorific title: Emperor Who Responds to Heaven, Broad in Fortune, Benevolent and Sagely, Civil and Martial, Supreme in Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The officials presented a jade-tablet honorific: Emperor Who Responds to Heaven, Broad in Fortune, Benevolent and Sagely, Civil and Martial, Supreme in Virtue.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，南唐進賀南郊、尊號銀絹萬計。

translations.literal: On bingyin Southern Tang presented silver and silk to congratulate the southern suburban sacrifice and the honorific title, counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Southern Tang sent myriad-fold silver and silk to congratulate the suburban rite and the new honorific.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜近臣襲衣、金帶、器幣、鞍馬有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao he bestowed on his close ministers court robes, gold belts, vessels, silks, saddles, and horses in graded gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he gave his intimates graded gifts of court robes, gold belts, vessels, silks, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On yihai he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，殿前祗候李璘以父讎殺員僚陳友，璘自首，義而釋之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, Palace Front attendant Li Lin killed staff colleague Chen You over his father's feud; Lin surrendered himself, and in righteousness he was released.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, Palace Front attendant Li Lin slew colleague Chen You to avenge his father, then gave himself up and was freed as an act of righteous vengeance.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，開封府尹光義、興元尹光美各益食邑，賜功臣號；

translations.literal: On xinsi Kaifeng intendant Guangyi and Xingyuan intendant Guangmei each had their food fiefs increased and were granted merit noble titles;
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Guangyi of Kaifeng and Guangmei of Xingyuan each received added food fiefs and new merit titles;

sentences.zh: 宰相質、溥、仁浦並特進，易封，益食邑；

translations.literal: Chancellors Zhi, Pu, and Renpu were all made Special Advance, had their enfeoffments changed, and had their food fiefs increased;
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors Fan Zhi, Wang Pu, and Wei Renpu were all advanced to Special Advance, given new fiefs, and granted larger food domains;

sentences.zh: 樞密使普加光祿大夫，易功臣號；

translations.literal: Military Affairs Commissioner Zhao Pu was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and given a new merit title;
translations.idiomatic: Military Affairs Commissioner Zhao Pu was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and given a new merit title;

sentences.zh: 文武臣僚各進階、勳、爵、邑。

translations.literal: civil and military officials each advanced in rank, merit orders, noble titles, and food fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: and civil and military officials were all promoted in rank, merit orders, titles, and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇后王氏崩。

translations.literal: On jiashen Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，罷登州都督。

translations.literal: On xinmao the area command of Dengzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Dengzhou area command was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，泉州陳洪進遣使貢白金千兩，乳香、茶藥皆萬計。

translations.literal: On jihai Chen Hongjin of Quanzhou sent envoys presenting a thousand taels of white gold, frankincense, and tea medicines, each counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Chen Hongjin of Quanzhou sent envoys with a thousand taels of white gold and vast stores of frankincense and medicinal tea.

sentences.zh: 己巳，南唐主上表乞呼名，詔不允。

translations.literal: On jisi the Southern Tang ruler memorialized begging to be addressed by personal name; an edict did not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Southern Tang ruler asked leave to be called by his personal name; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉朔，校醫官，黜其藝不精者二十二人。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the first day of the month, yiyou, medical officers were examined and twenty-two whose skill was not refined were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the first of the intercalary month, the court examined medical officers and dismissed twenty-two for poor skill.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命近臣祈雪。

translations.literal: On jiayin he ordered close ministers to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he sent close ministers to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，覆試拔萃科，田可封、宋白、譚利用等稱旨，賜與有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Outstanding Talent examination was re-held; Tian Kefeng, Song Bai, Tan Liyong, and others pleased the throne, and rewards were given in graded measure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Outstanding Talent examination was repeated; Tian Kefeng, Song Bai, Tan Liyong, and others won the emperor's favor and received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 辛未，卜安陵于鞏縣。

translations.literal: On xinwei the An Mausoleum was divined at Gong county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei diviners fixed the site of the An Mausoleum in Gong county.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，折德扆敗北漢軍於府州城下，禽其將楊璘。

translations.literal: On yihai Zhe Deyi defeated the Northern Han army below Fuzhou city and captured their general Yang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhe Deyi routed Northern Han beneath Fuzhou and took their general Yang Lin prisoner.

sentences.zh: 以太常議，奉赤帝為感生帝。

translations.literal: By the deliberation of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, the Red Emperor was honored as Procreative Spirit Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' advice, the Red Emperor was enthroned as Procreative Spirit Emperor.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，諭郡國長吏勸農耕作。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, the first month, on xinsi, the chief officials of circuits and prefectures were instructed to urge farming and plowing.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on xinsi in the first month, he ordered local chiefs in every circuit and prefecture to press the people to farm.

sentences.zh: 有象入南陽，虞人殺之，以齒、革來獻。

translations.literal: An elephant entered Nanyang; the park keeper killed it and presented its tusks and hide.
translations.idiomatic: An elephant wandered into Nanyang; the imperial huntsman killed it and sent up its tusks and hide.

sentences.zh: 京師雨雪、雷。

translations.literal: In the capital there was snow, rain, and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Snow, rain, and thunder struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On guiwei he visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to Welcome Spring Garden for a banquet and archery.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔著四時聽選式。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict codified the regulations for seasonal civil-service selection.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he promulgated regulations governing the four seasonal rounds of official selection.

sentences.zh: 回鶻遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghur envoys arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 戊子，質以太子太傅、溥以太子太保、仁浦仍尚書左僕射罷。

translations.literal: On wuzi Zhi was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Pu Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Renpu remained Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works—all were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Fan Zhi became Grand Mentor of the Heir, Wang Pu Grand Guardian of the Heir, and Wei Renpu kept his post as Left Vice Director of Works; all three left the council.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以趙普為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，李崇矩樞密使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Zhao Pu was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Joint Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat and Chancellery; Li Chongju was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhao Pu became Vice Director of the Chancellery and full chancellor, and Li Chongju commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔親試制舉三科，不限官庶，許直詣閣門進狀。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict ordered the emperor personally to examine the three categories of decree examination, with no restriction to officials or commoners, allowing direct submission of petitions at the Gatehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he decreed a personal examination of the three decree-examination categories, open to officials and commoners alike, who might submit petitions straight to the Gatehouse.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔諸道獄詞令大理、刑部檢詳，或淹留差失致中書門下改正者，重其罪。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict ordered that judicial records from the circuits be reviewed by the Court of Judicial Review and the Ministry of Justice; if delay or error caused the Secretariat and Chancellery to correct them, the penalty would be increased.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he required circuit case records to be reviewed by the Court of Judicial Review and the Ministry of Justice, with heavier punishment if delay or error forced the chancellery to intervene.

sentences.zh: 乙已，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On yisi he visited Jade Ford Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔縣令、簿、尉非公事毋至村落。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict ordered magistrates, registrars, and constables not to enter villages except on public business.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he forbade county magistrates, registrars, and constables to enter villages except on official business.

sentences.zh: 令、錄、簿、尉諸職官有耄耋篤疾者舉劾之。

translations.literal: Magistrates, recorders, registrars, and constables who were aged, senile, or gravely ill were to be impeached.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered impeachment of any magistrate, recorder, registrar, or constable who was aged, senile, or gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申朔，北漢遼州刺史杜延韜以城來降。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day of the month, wushen, Northern Han Liaozhou prefect Du Yanxian brought the city and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wushen, the first of the month, Du Yanxian of Northern Han's Liaozhou came over with his city.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣使振陝州饑。

translations.literal: On guichou envoys were sent to relieve famine in Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he sent commissioners with relief grain to famine-stricken Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 導潩水入京。

translations.literal: The Yi River was channeled into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Work diverted the Yi River into the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，治安陵，隧壞，役兵壓死者二百人，命有司瘞恤。

translations.literal: On dingsi construction of the An Mausoleum was underway; the tunnel collapsed and two hundred laboring soldiers were crushed to death; the responsible offices were ordered to bury and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, while the An Mausoleum was under construction, a tunnel collapse killed two hundred laborers; the court ordered burial and relief for the dead.

sentences.zh: 庚午，府州俘北漢衛州刺史楊璘來獻。

translations.literal: On gengwu the captive Northern Han Weizhou prefect Yang Lin was presented from Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Fuzhou presented the captured Northern Han prefect of Weizhou, Yang Lin.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，南唐進改葬安陵銀綾絹各萬計。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Southern Tang presented silver, brocade, and silk for the reburial at the An Mausoleum, each counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Southern Tang sent vast gifts of silver, brocade, and silk for the An Mausoleum reburial.

sentences.zh: 浚汴河。

translations.literal: The Bian Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian Canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，幸教船池，賜水軍將士衣有差，還幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi, he visited the Naval Drill Pool, bestowed clothing on the naval officers and men in graded gifts, and then visited Jade Ford Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi, he inspected the Naval Drill Pool, clothed the sailors in graded gifts, then feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙未，北漢耀州團練使周審玉等來降。

translations.literal: On yiwei Northern Han Yaozhou training commissioner Zhou Shenyu and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhou Shenyu, Northern Han training commissioner of Yaozhou, and others defected.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣使祈雨於五嶽。

translations.literal: On dingyou envoys were sent to pray for rain at the Five Sacred Peaks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he sent envoys to pray for rain on the Five Sacred Peaks.

sentences.zh: 禁臣僚往來假官軍部送。

translations.literal: Officials were forbidden to borrow government courier transport for private travel.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade officials to use government courier posts for private errands.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣攝太尉光義奉冊寶上明憲皇太后諡曰昭憲，皇后賀氏諡曰孝惠，王氏諡曰孝明。

translations.literal: On xinchou he dispatched Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies Guangyi to present seals and regalia and invest the Bright and Discerning Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Manifest and Commemorative, Empress He with the posthumous title Filial and Kind, and Empress Wang with the posthumous title Filial and Illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sent Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies Guangyi with seals and regalia to invest the Bright and Discerning Empress Dowager as Manifest and Commemorative, Empress He as Filial and Kind, and Empress Wang as Filial and Illustrious.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，策賢良方正直言極諫科，博州判官穎贄中第。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day of the month, dingwei, the Worthy and Good, Upright in Speech, and Outspoken in Remonstrance examination was held; Bozhou judge Ying Zan passed.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on dingwei, the first of the fourth month, the court held the Worthy, Upright, and Outspoken examination; Ying Zan, judge of Bozhou, passed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，振河中饑。

translations.literal: On wushen famine in the Hezhong circuit was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he sent relief to famine in the Hezhong circuit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免諸道今年夏稅之無苗者。

translations.literal: On jiyou this year's summer tax was remitted in every circuit where the fields bore no grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he remitted summer tax in every circuit where crops had failed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬昭憲皇太后、孝明皇后於安陵。

translations.literal: On yimao the Manifest and Commemorative Empress Dowager and the Filial and Illustrious Empress were buried at the An Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Manifest and Commemorative Empress Dowager and Empress Wang were buried at the An Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，始置參知政事，以兵部侍郎薛居正、呂餘慶為之。

translations.literal: On yichou the post of Vice Grand Councilor was first established; Vice Ministers of War Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he first created the office of Vice Grand Councilor and named Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing to it.

sentences.zh: 己已，靈武饑，轉涇粟以饟。

translations.literal: On jisi Lingwu suffered famine; grain from Jing was transferred to feed the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi famine struck Lingwu, and grain from Jing was shipped in as relief.

sentences.zh: 壬申，祔二后於別廟。

translations.literal: On renshen the two empresses were enshrined in the separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the two empresses were installed in the collateral shrine.

sentences.zh: 徙永州諸縣民之畜蠱者三百二十六家於縣之僻處，不得復齒於鄉。

translations.literal: Three hundred twenty-six households in Yongzhou counties who kept poison insects were moved to remote parts of their counties and might not again be counted among the village elders.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred twenty-six Yongzhou households convicted of keeping gu poison were resettled in remote hamlets and barred forever from village standing.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，知制誥高錫坐受藩鎮賂，貶萊州司馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, Drafting Officer Gao Xi was convicted of taking bribes from military commissioners and was demoted to militia commander of Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, drafting officer Gao Xi was demoted to Laizhou militia commander for taking bribes from commissioners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宗正卿趙礪坐贓杖、除籍。

translations.literal: On xinsi Director of the Imperial Clan Zhao Li was convicted of corruption, beaten with the staff, and struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhao Li, director of the imperial clan, was flogged and expelled from office for graft.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On guiwei he visited Jade Ford Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，以光義為中書令，光美同中書門下平章事，子德昭貴州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou, Guangyi was made Director of the Chancellery, Guangmei Joint Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat and Chancellery, and his son Dezhao defense commissioner of Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiyou, Guangyi became director of the Chancellery, Guangmei full chancellor, and his son Dezhao defense commissioner of Gui.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸相國寺，遂幸教船池、玉津園。

translations.literal: On gengshen he visited Xiangguo Temple, then visited the Naval Drill Pool and Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he went to Xiangguo Temple, then to the Naval Drill Pool and Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛未，河南北及秦諸州蝗，惟趙州不食稼。

translations.literal: On xinwei locusts struck Henan north and south and the Qin prefectures; only Zhaozhou's grain was untouched.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei locusts ravaged Henan, north and south, and the Qin prefectures, but Zhaozhou's crops alone escaped.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，春州暴水溺民。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yihai, a sudden flood in Chunzhou drowned the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yihai, a flash flood in Chunzhou drowned many people.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，郃陽雨雹。

translations.literal: On gengchen hail fell in Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen hail struck Heyang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On xinsi he visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he went to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 還幸新池，觀習水戰。

translations.literal: He then visited the New Pool to watch naval exercises.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to the New Pool to watch naval drills.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔翰林學士陶穀、竇儀舉堪為藩郡通判者各一人，不當者連坐。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict ordered Hanlin Academicians Tao Gu and Dou Yi each to recommend one man fit to serve as circuit military commissioner's deputy; if the nominee proved unfit, the recommender would be punished by association.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he required Hanlin academicians Tao Gu and Dou Yi each to name one man fit for circuit deputy commissioner, with collective punishment if the choice failed.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌朔，周易博士奚嶼責乾州司戶，庫部員外王貽孫責左讚善大夫，並坐試任子不公。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day of the month, jiaxu, Erudite of the Changes Xi Yu was demoted to militia commander of Qian, Outer Gentleman of the Stores Wang Yisun was demoted to Left Supporter of the Heir—both for unfairness in testing yin-privilege appointees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the first of the ninth month, Xi Yu, erudite of the Changes, was demoted to Qian militia commander and Wang Yisun, outer gentleman of the Stores, to left supporter of the heir, both for rigging yin-privilege examinations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，延州雨雹。

translations.literal: On wuzi hail fell in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi hail fell in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸北郊觀稼。

translations.literal: On yiwei he visited the northern suburbs to inspect the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he went to the northern suburbs to inspect the grain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太子太傅質薨。

translations.literal: On xinchou Grand Mentor of the Heir Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fan Zhi, Grand Mentor of the Heir, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，潘美等克郴州。

translations.literal: On renyin Pan Mei and others took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Pan Mei and others captured Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，周紀王熙謹薨，輟視朝。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wushen, Prince Ji of Zhou Xijin died, and court audiences were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wushen, Prince Ji of Zhou, Xijin, died, and the court suspended audiences.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，命忠武軍節度使王全斌為西川行營前軍兵馬都部署，武信軍節度崔彥進副之，將步騎三萬出鳳州道；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Loyal Martial military commissioner Wang Quanbin was made overall commander of the vanguard army of the Western Sichuan campaign, with Wuxin military commissioner Cui Yanjin as his deputy, leading thirty thousand foot and horse out by the Fengzhou route;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Wang Quanbin, commissioner of the Loyal Martial army, was named overall commander of the Western Sichuan vanguard with Wuxin commissioner Cui Yanjin as deputy, marching thirty thousand foot and horse by the Fengzhou road;

sentences.zh: 江寧軍節度使劉光義為西川行營前軍兵馬副都部署，樞密承旨曹彬副之，將步騎二萬出歸州道以伐蜀。

translations.literal: Jiangning military commissioner Liu Guangyi was made deputy overall commander of the vanguard army of the Western Sichuan campaign, with Bureau of Military Affairs recipient Cao Bin as his deputy, leading twenty thousand foot and horse out by the Guizhou route to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangyi of Jiangning became deputy overall commander with Cao Bin of the Bureau of Military Affairs as his deputy, leading twenty thousand by the Guizhou road to invade Shu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宴西川行營將校于崇德殿，示川峽地圖，授攻取方略，賜金玉帶、衣物各有差。

translations.literal: On yihai he feasted the Western Sichuan campaign generals in the Hall of Reverent Virtue, displayed a map of the Sichuan gorges, handed down plans of attack, and bestowed jade belts, clothing, and other gifts in graded measure.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he feasted the Shu generals in the Hall of Reverent Virtue, showed them a map of the gorges, set out the strategy, and gave graded gifts of jade belts and robes.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On renchen he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，釋廣南郴州都監陳琄等二百人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yisi, Chen Xuan and two hundred others, custodians of Chenzhou in southern Guang, were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yisi, Chen Xuan and two hundred other Guangnan custodians of Chenzhou were freed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，劉光義拔夔州，蜀節度高彥儔自焚。

translations.literal: On wushen Liu Guangyi took Kuizhou; Shu military commissioner Gao Yanchou burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Liu Guangyi seized Kuizhou, and Shu commissioner Gao Yanchou burned himself alive.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，蠲歸、峽秋稅。

translations.literal: On dingsi autumn tax in Gui and Xia was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he remitted autumn tax in Gui and Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王全斌克萬仞、燕子二砦，下興州，連拔石圌等二十餘砦。

translations.literal: On xinyou Wang Quanbin took the Wanyue and Yanzi forts, then Xingzhou, and in succession seized more than twenty forts including Shiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Wang Quanbin captured the Wanyue and Yanzi forts, took Xingzhou, and swept more than twenty strongholds including Shiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，光義拔巫山等砦，斬蜀將南光海等八千級，禽其戰櫂都指揮袁德宏等千二百人。

translations.literal: On jiazi Guangyi took the Wushan forts and others, beheading more than eight thousand Shu soldiers at the grade of Nan Guanghai and others, and capturing battle-fleet overall commander Yuan Dehong and more than twelve hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Guangyi stormed the Wushan forts, took eight thousand heads including general Nan Guanghai's, and captured fleet commander Yuan Dehong with twelve hundred men.

sentences.zh: 全斌先鋒史進德敗蜀人於三泉砦，禽其節度使韓保正、李進等。

translations.literal: Wang Quanbin's vanguard Shi Jinde defeated the Shu at Sanquan Fort and captured their military commissioners Han Baozheng and Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quanbin's vanguard Shi Jinde routed Shu at Sanquan Fort and took commissioners Han Baozheng and Li Jin prisoner.

sentences.zh: 南唐進銀二萬兩、金銀器皿數百事。

translations.literal: Southern Tang presented twenty thousand taels of silver and several hundred gold and silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent twenty thousand taels of silver and several hundred gold and silver vessels.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔招復山林聚匿。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict offered amnesty to those who had hidden in mountains and forests.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he proclaimed amnesty for outlaws and refugees hiding in the hills.

sentences.zh: 辛未，畋北郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei he hunted in the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he hunted in the northern suburbs.
